items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: London, England URL: https://www.mobiloud.com Work location: Remote, anywhere outside the United States Sales territory: North America, UK, and EU Contract type: Full-time contractor Compensation: Competitive base plus commissions tied to closed revenue About MobiLoud MobiLoud helps established ecommerce brands turn their existing websites into iOS and Android apps, without rebuilding their product or running a second system. Our customers use MobiLoud to drive repeat purchases, recover abandoned carts through push notifications, and reduce their dependence on paid acquisition. We're a bootstrapped, profitable, remote-first SaaS company founded in 2013. We've published 2,000+ apps and have hundreds of active customers today, including Estee Lauder, John Varvatos, Jack & Jones, and Tadashi Shoji. Our team is 16 people, all remote and hands-on. The Role Email and SMS still drive revenue for ecommerce brands, but deliverability, SMS compliance, and acquisition costs keep making retention harder. A mobile app gives their best customers another direct channel through push notifications, tied to the website they already operate. That is the sale. You own the close for ecommerce brands across North America, the UK, and Europe. Discovery, demo, proposal, pricing conversations, contracting, and getting the signature on the order form are all part of the job. Most buyers are founders, ecommerce leads, digital directors, and marketing leaders. This is an inbound-led closing role: meetings come mainly from inbound demand, SDR-sourced pipeline, older opportunities, and referrals. You turn the right opportunities into signed customers. This posting is for candidates based outside the United States. You can be anywhere if you can work with UK/EU hours and have regular overlap with US East Coast business hours for demos and buyer conversations. You need to sound natural with North American and European buyers, understand how DTC ecommerce brands think, and learn the mobile app revenue case quickly. What You'll Do • Run discovery with inbound and SDR-sourced prospects • Lead demos tied to the prospect's site, traffic, retention stack, and commercial goals • Build the proposal, pricing case, and ROI narrative • Run pricing and commercial conversations • Manage the contracting process through signature and handoff • Follow up on stalled deals and re-engage older good-fit opportunities • Keep the CRM current, with clear next steps, close dates, and deal notes Who You Are • You have closed B2B deals before and can talk clearly about deal size, sales cycle, buyer type, win rate, objections, and what you personally owned • You have SaaS or software sales experience, ideally with products that require some technical understanding: websites, integrations, ecommerce platforms, apps, implementation, or developer-adjacent work • You have native or near-native English. Written and spoken English both need to feel natural to US, Canadian, UK, and EU buyers • You understand North American business culture, buying expectations, consumer brands, ecommerce, DTC, and how senior buyers like to communicate • You can sell to founders, heads of digital, ecommerce leads, and marketing leaders without sounding scripted • You are comfortable learning both the commercial and technical side of ecommerce: retention, repeat purchase, owned channels, paid acquisition pressure, websites, mobile apps, integrations, and why brands invest in apps • You can work with UK/EU hours and have regular overlap with US East Coast business hours for demos and buyer conversations Compensation • Competitive base plus commissions tied to closed revenue • Full-time independent contractor basis. You invoice monthly and handle your own tax obligations • You may be based anywhere outside the United States. MobiLoud pays in USD Why This Role • You sell to established ecommerce brands with real revenue and clear commercial problems • Direct line to the founder. Deal review, pricing decisions, and feedback happen quickly • You work on apps for brands like Estee Lauder, John Varvatos, Jack & Jones, and Tadashi Shoji • Remote contractor role with competitive USD compensation, commission upside, and no office requirement • Set your own hours and take unlimited time off. Give notice when you're out, that's the only rule Not a Fit If • You are based in the United States • You have not closed B2B deals before • You have not personally sold software or SaaS before • Your English is good but still too formal, scripted, or unnatural for North American buyers • You do not follow ecommerce, DTC brands, North American consumer culture, or how online brands grow • You need close daily management to stay focused How to Apply Email jobs@mobiloud.com with the subject line Account Executive - MobiLoud. Include: • Where you are based, and how your working day overlaps with UK/EU and US East Coast business hours • A recent B2B software or SaaS deal you personally closed: what you sold, who the buyer was, deal size, sales cycle, and what you owned from discovery through signature • How many new-logo B2B deals you personally closed in the last 12 months • One ecommerce or DTC brand you think could sell well through a mobile app, and why • Your CV and LinkedIn profile To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/mobiloud-account-executive

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Syracuse, NY, USA URL: http://freseniusmedicalcare.com ADDENDUM: Sales Consultant, Hospital Solutions In addition to the responsibilities outlined in the core job description, the Sales Consultant, Hospital Solutions will: Manage all new and existing accounts, identifies and closes new business opportunities, and delivers comprehensive solutions across the full product portfolio for both In Center and Hospital. PURPOSE AND SCOPE: This role is responsible for supporting sales growth and customer engagement driving sales performance, clinical support, and overall customer service within an assigned sales territory. The position manages new and existing accounts, provides product and clinical support, and identifies opportunities to expand utilization across the portfolio. The role builds and maintains strong customer relationships, leads territory-level collaboration with internal partners, and ensures accurate use of sales tools, forecasting, and contract management. PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: Manage all new and existing accounts, identifies and closes new business opportunities, and delivers comprehensive solutions across the full product portfolio for both In Center and Hospital. Own all accounts in assigned territory, new and existing account relationships, and represent the entire product portfolio for assigned modalities. Identify and close new opportunities by developing appropriate solutions and delivering implementation support across all customer types Manage and nurture account relationships to drive expansion and renewals, secure wallet share and demonstrate problem solving to customers as needs arise. Engages in regular face to face customer call activity. Leads collaboration and coordination with all supporting roles to handle customer needs and expectations Use FME sales tools daily to effectively manage prospects, existing accounts, opportunities, pipeline and forecast in an accurate and timely manner. Maintain accurate and timely management of customer contracts, including pricing adjustments and system updates. Identify market trends, threats, and opportunities using sales data and customer feedback, and develop strategic plans to improve performance and market share within assigned territory. Build strong customer relationships by delivering value-driven solutions and providing exceptional follow-up and service to internal and external customers. Support field activities, including equipment evaluations, in-services, technical demonstrations, and training, to ensure customer success. Monitor and maintain customer market share, entering and closing customer appointments and capturing relevant sales campaign data. Develop professional expertise and maintain technical and clinical proficiency across assigned modalities. Attend local, regional, and national events, meetings, and training sessions to enhance product knowledge, market understanding, and professional growth. Exercise good judgment within defined procedures and practices to determine appropriate action. Reviews and complies with the Code of Business Conduct and all applicable company compliance policies and procedures, local, state and federal laws and regulations. Assists with various projects as assigned by direct supervisor. Completes all administrative duties as assigned by direct supervisor such as accurate and timely expense reports and operates within operating expense budget. Other duties as assigned. Additional responsibilities may include focus on one or more departments or locations. See applicable addendum for department or location specific functions. PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORKING CONDITIONS : The physical demands and work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Must be able to physically cover and maintain regular face-to-face contact with customers over a assigned geographic area. Extensive travel by automobile/train/airplane is often necessary to cover assigned territory which includes overnight stays. Contact with customers by phone alone is not adequate. Occasional weekend work is necessary to support trade show events. Lifting requirements involve setting up portable booths, occasional lifting up to 50lbs, and transporting medical equipment and supplies for purposes of in-servicing customers. Must reside within assigned territory. EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS : Bachelor’s Degree required; advanced degree preferred or equivalent experience. Minimum 2-5 years’ related medical sales experience. Experience and proven success with consultative selling; approach and methodology Demonstrates effective presentation skills, professional and executive presence, and effectively establishes credibility with any audience. items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: US - California - Thousand Oaks URL: http://amgen.com Career Category Marketing Job Description What you will do Let's do this. Let's change the world. At Amgen, our shared mission—to serve patients—drives everything we do. Within the US Bone Health Business Unit, we have set a bold ambition to help prevent 3 million osteoporotic fractures by 2033 by transforming how osteoporosis is recognized, diagnosed, treated, and prioritized across the healthcare ecosystem. Achieving this ambition requires more than innovative medicines—it requires transforming the osteoporosis ecosystem through stakeholder alignment, disease awareness, innovation, and coordinated action. Bone IMPACT (Igniting Momentum through Policy, Alliances, Communications, and Technology) is Amgen's enterprise above-brand strategy to advance this ambition by mobilizing partners across the healthcare ecosystem and creating the conditions that improve disease awareness, diagnosis, treatment, and fracture prevention. The Marketing Director, Bone IMPACT will lead the evolution of Amgen's enterprise market-shaping strategy for osteoporosis by identifying, prioritizing, and advancing initiatives that transform the future osteoporosis landscape. Working across Marketing, Medical, Health Systems, Government Affairs, Corporate Communications, Advocacy, Value & Access, HEOR, Legal, Regulatory, Compliance, and external stakeholders, this leader will shape strategy, build strategic partnerships, identify emerging opportunities, and align organizational capabilities to accelerate meaningful improvements in osteoporosis care, with the opportunity to build a team and develop talent as the capability expands. This is a unique opportunity to help build one of Amgen's most strategic enterprise capabilities while shaping the future of osteoporosis care for one of the largest and most underserved patient populations in healthcare. Success in this highly visible leadership role requires strategic thinking, influence without authority, external partnership leadership, and the ability to translate bold ideas into executable strategies within a complex, highly regulated environment. Key Responsibilities Lead Enterprise Strategy & Cross-Functional Leadership Develop the long-term Bone IMPACT vision and enterprise strategy aligned with Bone Health business priorities. Identify emerging opportunities that strengthen the osteoporosis ecosystem and accelerate disease awareness, diagnosis, treatment, and fracture prevention. Lead above-brand market-shaping initiatives by aligning priorities across Marketing, Medical, Health Systems, Government Affairs, Corporate Communications, Advocacy, Value & Access, HEOR, and other key functions. Establish governance and integrated planning to align initiatives, partnerships, sponsorships, and investments around shared strategic priorities. Incubate innovative capabilities, evaluate impact, and transition mature initiatives to long-term business owners while identifying new opportunities for growth. Lead National Partnerships & Ecosystem Leadership Build trusted relationships with national medical societies, advocacy organizations, professional associations, health systems, technology companies, policy organizations, and other influential stakeholders. Convene strategic coalitions and partnerships that advance shared priorities through education, advocacy, innovation, and implementation initiatives. Represent Amgen as a trusted enterprise partner committed to advancing the osteoporosis ecosystem. Monitor the external environment to identify new partnerships, collaborations, and market-shaping opportunities. Lead Above-Brand Strategic Communications & Market Activation Develop enterprise above-brand communication and market activation strategies that elevate osteoporosis as a national healthcare priority. Shape evidence-based disease narratives that connect osteoporosis to broader conversations around women's health, menopause, healthy aging, longevity, and fracture prevention. Identify opportunities to leverage strategic communications, public awareness, partnerships, thought leadership, and emerging media to accelerate stakeholder engagement and market transformation. Partner across Brand Marketing, Corporate Communications, Medical, Advocacy, Government Affairs, Health Systems, Value & Access, and external agencies to ensure above-brand engagement strategies complement branded marketing while advancing enterprise priorities. Lead the strategy—and, as appropriate, the development and execution—of enterprise above-brand awareness and market activation initiatives. Lead Innovation & Future Market Development With cross-functional partners, evaluate emerging trends, AI-enabled capabilities, technologies, and strategic partnerships to identify new opportunities that transform osteoporosis awareness, patient engagement, and care delivery. Translate external insights into business cases, pilot initiatives, and scalable enterprise strategies. Foster a culture of innovation by identifying opportunities that position Bone IMPACT to address future market needs. Measure Impact & Optimize Strategy Define success measures that evaluate ecosystem impact, stakeholder engagement, partnership effectiveness, market activation, and strategic progress. Monitor performance and refine enterprise priorities based on market insights and measurable outcomes. Manage agency partners, external vendors, and program budgets to maximize impact and return on investment. Present strategic recommendations, market insights, and enterprise progress to senior leadership to inform business decisions and future investment priorities. <>· What we expect of you We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The strategic leader we seek is an enterprise thinker who thrives in ambiguity, builds trusted partnerships, and mobilizes diverse stakeholders to create meaningful change across the healthcare ecosystem. Basic Qualifications Doctorate degree and 4 years of marketing, communications, public affairs, advocacy, commercial, medical, or related biotechnology experience OR Master's degree and7 years of marketing, communications, public affairs, advocacy, commercial, medical, or related biotechnology experience OR Bachelor's degree and 9 years of marketing, communications, public affairs, advocacy, commercial, medical, or related biotechnology experience Preferred Qualifications MBA, MPH, MHA, or other advanced degree. 10+ years of progressively increasing responsibility within biotechnology, healthcare, advocacy, communications, consulting, or related industries. Demonstrated success developing enterprise or above-brand strategies that influence healthcare markets beyond individual products. Experience building strategic partnerships with national medical societies, advocacy organizations, health systems, policy organizations, technology companies, or other influential stakeholders. Experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives and influencing senior leaders without direct authority. Understanding of the U.S. healthcare ecosystem, including health systems, policy, advocacy, population health, quality improvement, and value-based care. Experience leading strategic communications, public awareness, advocacy, stakeholder engagement, or market activation initiatives within healthcare or other highly regulated industries. Demonstrated ability to identify emerging opportunities and translate insights into innovative strategies and executable business plans. Demonstrated ability to develop market-shaping strategies while navigating legal, regulatory, and compliance requirements. Strong executive presence with exceptional communication, facilitation, and relationship-building skills. Proven ability to manage ambiguity, prioritize effectively, and deliver results across multiple complex initiatives. Experience leading agencies, external partners, and cross-functional teams to achieve measurable business and patient impact. . items.description: Design Headquarters: Dire Dawa, Ethiopia URL: http://iisd.org Background The Scaling Urban Nature-based Solutions (NbS) for Climate Adaptation in Sub-Saharan Africa (SUNCASA) is a 3-year project aiming at enhancing climate resilience and promoting gender equality, social inclusion, and biodiversity protection across three cities: Dire Dawa (Ethiopia), Kigali (Rwanda) and Johannesburg (South Africa). Led by the International Institute for Sustainable Development and the World Resources Institute, and implemented in partnership with local organizations and communities, SUNCASA seeks to address climate change impacts—such as floods, landslides, and soil erosion—through gender-responsive and socially inclusive NbS. These include afforestation, reforestation, agroforestry, urban greening, the removal of invasive alien species, and the creation of vegetated buffer zones in flood-prone areas. Entering its third and final year of the current implementation phase, SUNCASA is already achieving significant results, generating measurable adaptation outcomes and strengthening the resilience of communities and landscapes across its project sites. To sustain these achievements beyond the project time frame, SUNCASA is investing in building local ownership and stewardship, with a particular emphasis on engaging children and youth as future custodians of their environments. For more information, visit www.suncasa.org . As part of this effort, SUNCASA is developing a series of four animated videos, with stories and scripts co-created alongside local partners to ensure they reflect community realities, priorities, and cultural contexts. Through engaging storytelling and accessible messages, the animations will encourage young audiences to understand the importance of protecting local ecosystems and livelihoods, recognize their role in sustaining climate adaptation efforts, and contribute to building more resilient and sustainable communities. Purpose of the Consultancy Within the framework of SUNCASA’s Communications Strategy, IISD is seeking an experienced animator or animation studio to conceptualize, design, and produce a series of three animated videos showcasing the project's NbS impacts and highlighting the role of local youth in sustaining these achievements across SUNCASA's three project cities. A fourth animation will focus on promoting the project's gender equality and social inclusion (GESI) approach. Working closely with SUNCASA's Communications team and representatives from the project's local partners, the consultant will be responsible for translating existing scripts into engaging visual narratives through the development of high-quality animations of approximately 2–2.5 minutes each. The videos should communicate the project's approach, results, and impact in a way that is compelling, accessible, and suitable for diverse audiences, with a particular focus on young people. Animations and supporting illustrations must be designed on Adobe Creative Cloud software—After Effects, Illustrator, and InDesign. SUNCASA will provide relevant reference materials—including photographs, videos, project documentation, and brand assets—to inform the visual concept, character design, and storytelling. The animations will be based on scripts co-created with local partners to ensure they authentically reflect the social, cultural, and environmental contexts of each project location. The consultant will be expected to develop a distinctive visual style that resonates with local audiences while maintaining consistency across the animation series. The animations are expected to be developed primarily in English. The SUNCASA Communications team will provide all voiceover and dialogue recordings, including versions in local languages such as Amharic, Afaan Oromo, and Kinyarwanda, which the consultant will integrate into the final productions. The assignment covers the full animation production process, including visual concept development, character and environment design, storyboarding, illustration, animation, editing, and post-production. Final deliverables will include landscape and portrait versions of each animation, optimized for web, social media, and mobile platforms. The consultant will also provide all editable source files—including artwork, illustrations, animation assets, and project files—to allow future adaptation and reuse by the SUNCASA Communications team. The completed animations will support educational and awareness-raising activities led by SUNCASA’s local partners, particularly among children and youth. They will also be disseminated through community WhatsApp and Telegram groups and promoted through SUNCASA’s and partners’ websites and social media channels, helping to expand outreach, strengthen engagement, and reinforce the long-term sustainability of project outcomes. Objectives of the Consultancy General Objective The overall objective of this consultancy is to design and produce a series of four short, animated videos that communicate the achievements and impacts of the SUNCASA project in an engaging and accessible way. This includes three animations highlighting the project’s NbS interventions and their contribution to community and ecosystem resilience across three cities, while one will focus on SUNCASA’s GESI approach. The animations aim to strengthen local ownership and long-term sustainability of project results by engaging children and youth as key audiences. Through culturally relevant storytelling co-developed with local partners, the animations should inspire behavioural change and reinforce the role of youth as key agents of resilience and environmental stewardship. The final products will serve as adaptable communication tools for community outreach, education, and broader dissemination through digital platforms and partner networks. Specific Objectives To design and produce four high-quality animated videos (approximately 2–2.5 minutes each) that communicate SUNCASA’s results, impacts, and approaches in an engaging, accessible, and visually compelling format, particularly to younger audiences. To develop three animations showcasing SUNCASA’s NbS interventions and their contribution to strengthening the resilience of communities and ecosystems across the project’s three cities. To produce one animation highlighting SUNCASA’s GESI approach and its role in promoting inclusive and equitable climate adaptation outcomes. To lead the full animation production process, including visual concept development, character and environment design, storyboarding, illustration, animation, editing, and post-production, in close collaboration with SUNCASA’s Communications team and local partners. To deliver final outputs in both landscape and portrait formats, as well as short versions of each video optimized for social media, along with all editable source files (including artwork, illustrations, animation assets, and project files) to enable future adaptation and reuse by the SUNCASA Communications team. Tasks and Deliverables The consultant will be responsible for leading the full animation production process as outlined below: Activity 1: Inception and Creative Development Review all aesthetics and visual reference materials provided by SUNCASA. Participate in a kickoff meeting with the SUNCASA Communications teams and representatives of the local partner organizations. Develop a creative concept and visual approach aligned with SUNCASA branding and the visual references provided. Prepare a detailed production plan and timeline, including at least three rounds of feedback and the platform on which concepts and drafts will be shared for review. Deliverable 1 : Detailed work plan, including time frame; Creative concept with animation style and visual approach. Activity 2: Storyboards - Based on the co-created scripts provided by the SUNCASA Communications team and informed by the approved creative concept, the consultant will design individual storyboards for each animation. Deliverable 2 : Individual storyboards for each video, with a detailed description of each sequence and scene. Activity 3 : Initial Video Drafts - Following the scripts provided by the SUNCASA Comms team and the approved storyboard, the consultant will develop initial versions of all four animations with no audio and submit them for review. Based on feedback, the updated versions will be created and submitted for approval. - Drafts should include motion graphics, character animations, as well as maps and geographic visualization where applicable. Deliverable 3 : The initial and updated cut of each video animation draft with no audio, including the feedback provided by the team. Activity 4: Final versions of all four animated videos in English and integration of voiceover, dialogues in local languages, as well as soundtrack; create cut-down social media cuts - The consultant will use the approved versions to integrate the voiceover, dialogues, and soundtrack into each animation. - In addition to English, one animation will have a version in Kinyarwanda; and one will have versions in Amharic and Afaan Oromo—translations to be provided by the SUNCASA Communications team. - An additional round of feedback will be required at this stage before approval of the final versions. - In addition to the full animations, the consultant will deliver a cut-down version (30 to 45 seconds) of each video, optimized for social media. Deliverable 4 : A final version of each animation in English with voiceover, dialogues, and soundtrack in local languages, as applicable. A cut-down version of each animation for social media. Activity 5: Submit all editable source files (including artwork, illustrations, animation assets, and project files) - Organize, name, and share all working files, including artwork, illustrations, animation assets, and project files. Deliverable 5 : A folder with all required assets to be shared with the SUNCASA Communications team. Read the full Terms of Reference here for Reporting, Evaluation and Selection Criteria. Consultancy for the Design and Production of Four Animated Videos Showcasing SUNCASA’s Achievements and Inspiring Youth Engagement in Sustaining Project Results Application deadline: August 3, 2026 Application Process All applications must be submitted in English. To apply for this consultancy, please send: Cover Letter outlining relevant professional experience of proposed consultant(s). Please include the name and contact details of the primary contact person. Detailed resume of proposed consultant(s) highlighting relevant experience in all stages of animation production, from creative concept to post-production. Technical Proposal outlining understanding of the assignment and how the consultant(s) plan to undertake the project, including a proposed work plan and timeline. The proposed work plan must align with the deliverables and timeline set out in Sections 4 and 5. Portfolio with at least three examples of relevant animation videos. Please indicate the links to the videos in the technical proposal. Financial Proposal that includes the consultant’s daily rate and any additional costs associated with this assignment, with all costs clearly broken down and aligned to each deliverable and key activities outlined in the Scope of Work. Financial proposals must be aligned with the scope described in Section 5 of this RFP. At least two (2) references from previous related projects. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/iisd-consultancy-for-the-design-and-production-of-four-animated-videos-showcasing-suncasa-s-achievements-and

The ideal candidate understands how to build characters with personality, backstory, and a strong visual identity while ensuring the designs translate efficiently into 3D production and animation. About the Project We are looking for an experienced 2D Character Concept Artist to create the key characters for a new game project. The project's setting blends science fiction, cyberpunk, a utopian world, and grounded atmospheric realism. References for the desired mood and level of quality include Death Stranding, Cyberpunk 2077, and modern AAA RPGs. Your primary responsibility will be to create a unique visual identity for a character that will serve as the foundation for 3D modeling, rigging, animation, and in-game implementation. Responsibilities Develop the visual concept of a character based on a creative brief. Research and collect relevant visual references. Create multiple concept directions and design variations. Design and refine the character's silhouette, proportions, outfit, equipment, accessories, and overall visual language. Produce a high-quality final character concept. Prepare production-ready materials for the 3D team. Create turnaround sheets (front, side, and back views). Prepare detailed callout sheets for clothing, materials, equipment, and structural elements. Collaborate with the Art Director to refine the character's artistic direction. Implement revisions based on feedback and review sessions. Expected Deliverables The final package should include all assets required for 3D production: Final approved character design. Fully rendered color concept. Character Sheet. Turnaround (Front / Side / Back). Detailed callout sheets for key design elements. Material and texture references. Layered PSD files with a well-organized layer structure. Requirements Proven experience as a Concept Artist or Character Designer in the game industry. Strong understanding of character design principles. Solid knowledge of human anatomy. Ability to work in both realistic and semi-realistic art styles. Experience creating production-ready designs suitable for 3D pipelines. Proficiency in Photoshop, Procreate, or equivalent software. Good understanding of the full game character production pipeline. A strong portfolio featuring characters for games, films, or AAA productions. Nice to Have Experience designing characters for sci-fi, cyberpunk, or post-apocalyptic settings. Understanding of 3D character modeling and animation workflows. Experience using AI tools during research and visual exploration. Experience collaborating with outsourcing teams and game studios. Working conditions: Our people are what we value the most at iLogos. We treat everyone with respect no matter where you are from or what you believe in. If you share our values which are Mastery, Maturity, Trust & Care, and Positive Mindset – we are a perfect match for each other! Join #ilogos_team and we guarantee you an opportunity for growth, support, and an atmosphere of trust and care that feels more like a family. And as well: Work remotely from anywhere in the world. Flexible working hours. Contract duration: approximately 3 months , with the possibility of extension based on project needs and mutual agreement. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/ilogos-2d-character-concept-artist

items.summary: Manager, Benefit Verification & Authorization Operations Salary Range: $80k-$90k The Role The Manager, Benefit Verification & Authorization Operations is responsible for leading Prompt’s Benefit Verification and Authorization teams, ensuring accurate, timely, and consistent execution across our RCM clients. This role directly manages the Benefit Ve
items.description: Manager, Benefit Verification & Authorization Operations Salary Range: $80k-$90k The Role The Manager, Benefit Verification & Authorization Operations is responsible for leading Prompt’s Benefit Verification and Authorization teams, ensuring accurate, timely, and consistent execution across our RCM clients. This role directly manages the Benefit Verification and Authorization Team Leads and is accountable for overall team performance, quality, service levels, and operational efficiency. The Manager will use data to identify performance gaps, resolve escalations, develop team leaders, and continuously improve processes that support patient access and prevent downstream billing and reimbursement issues. Key Responsibilities Team Leadership & Operations Lead the Benefit Verification and Authorization functions, ensuring teams consistently meet quality, productivity, and turnaround-time expectations. Directly manage and develop the Benefit Verification and Authorization Team Leads. Ensure workloads, staffing, and priorities are aligned with client volumes and business needs. Establish clear expectations and accountability across both teams. Support Team Leads with complex operational, payer, client, and employee escalations. Build a high-performing culture centered on accuracy, urgency, accountability, and ownership. Performance & Quality Own key performance metrics and SLAs across Benefit Verification and Authorization. Monitor verification accuracy, turnaround times, authorization approval rates, pending authorizations, backlog, productivity, and authorization-related denials. Use reporting and dashboards to identify performance gaps, payer trends, and operational risks. Partner with Team Leads to implement corrective action plans when performance falls below expectations. Ensure consistent quality assurance and auditing processes are in place across both teams. Operational Oversight & Escalations Ensure patients have accurate benefit information and required authorizations are identified and managed appropriately. Ensure teams proactively identify missing, pending, expiring, or exhausted authorizations before they impact scheduled visits or reimbursement. Serve as the management-level escalation point for complex payer, client, and workflow issues. Analyze recurring verification and authorization issues to identify root causes and prevent future occurrences. Partner with Billing, AR, and other RCM teams to reduce downstream denials and reimbursement delays. Process Improvement Identify opportunities to improve Benefit Verification and Authorization workflows, accuracy, and scalability. Standardize processes and best practices across teams and clients. Identify opportunities for automation and system improvements that reduce manual work. Partner with RCM leadership, Product, and BI on reporting, workflow, and system enhancements. Ensure process and system changes are effectively communicated, implemented, and monitored. Training & Team Development Ensure Team Leads have effective onboarding, training, and ongoing coaching programs in place. Develop Team Leads into strong operational leaders who can independently manage daily team performance. Identify knowledge and skill gaps and ensure appropriate training is provided. Maintain clear SOPs, payer resources, and workflow documentation across both functions. Minimum Requirements 5+ years of experience in healthcare revenue cycle management, patient access, Benefit Verification, Prior Authorization, or related healthcare operations. 2+ years of people management experience, preferably within healthcare operations. Strong knowledge of insurance eligibility, benefits, prior authorization, and payer requirements. Experience managing teams against productivity, quality, and turnaround-time expectations. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify root causes and implement solutions. Demonstrated ability to manage complex operational and payer escalations. Strong leadership, coaching, and performance management skills. Experience improving and standardizing operational processes. Experience with practice management systems, payer portals, healthcare technology platforms, and reporting tools. Ability to operate independently and effectively manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment. HIPAA Requirements All associates are required to comply with the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) regulations regarding the protection of patient health information. This includes adherence to the organization’s Notice of Privacy Practices and HIPAA Privacy Policies and Procedures. The specific statements provided in this job description are not exhaustive and may be subject to change based on evolving business needs. Associates may be required to perform additional duties as assigned.

items.description: DevOps and Sysadmin Headquarters: ignitionit.com URL: https://ignitionit.com APPLY HERE: https://go.cultureindex.com/p/bLvP56CvGHU Fully Remote · Work from home · Full-time (Eastern or Pacific time zones) · Apple-first TL;DR ignitionit.com is a seasoned, Apple-first MSP — in business for almost 30 years — and we're hiring a Help Desk Technician to be the friendly, capable first voice our clients reach when something isn't working. This position is a remote, work-from-home, full-time role. We've written this as a junior-to-mid-level job description because that's where most great people start on our team. But if you're more seasoned — comfortable in identity, MDM, or security work — don't scroll past. We'd be delighted to find someone who can step in higher up the ladder, and we'll happily talk about a more senior scope and comp if that's you. What the actual job??? Unlike many IT shops, we believe that the technology is the tactic. The actual job is making people feel taken care of. One of our core values is “49% tech support, 51% human support.” You'll succeed by configuring devices, resetting access, untangling email, and chasing down the gremlin that's been haunting someone's conference room. But you'll know you succeeded when a client exhales and says, “Thank goodness you're on it!” That Warm Fuzzy Feeling™ is the actual product. The green lights on the dashboard are just how we get there. In a typical week, you might: Onboard a new hire at a fast-growing startup: provision their Mac, set up their Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 accounts, enroll the device in MDM, and make sure day one feels effortless. Offboard a departing employee cleanly — recover the laptop, revoke access, and close the loop so nothing's left dangling. All boxes checked, ticket notated and closed, client followed up with. Field a "my email stopped working" ticket that turns out to be a DNS thing, a phishing-filter thing, or a "they changed their password on their phone three weeks ago" thing. Help a family office or RIA get a touchy Zoom Room or conference-room AV setup behaving before a meeting — over the phone. Triage the queue so phones get answered fast, emails don't rot, and nobody feels forgotten — even when the honest answer is, “We're on it, but here's the realistic timeline." ⠀ You'll be the front line: helping with what you can, researching what you can't, and pinging the rest of the team when you're genuinely stuck. That last part is a skill, not a weakness — knowing when to ask is half the job. About ignitionit.com We're one of the oldest Apple Technical Partners on the planet, and one of the only certified Apple Premier Partners — that’s kinda like getting knighted by the ghost of Steve Jobs. We started where you’d expect to find Macs (creative agencies, non-profits, education) but our primary clients today are cutting-edge, venture-backed AI SaaS startups, VC and private equity firms, registered investment advisors — many of them operating under stringent compliance expectations (SOC 2, SEC). That means we hold ourselves to a higher standard than the scrappy shop we started as. Polished, reliable, security-minded work is the baseline now — but always with a smile! What hasn't changed: relationships are still our most valuable currency — with clients, with vendors, and with each other. We're a tight, supportive team. We teach each other what we know, cover for each other when life throws a punch, and care a little too much about doing things the right way. We're still a bit weird, and our clients seem to like us that way. We move fast, priorities shift, it’s not always documented (whatever it is), our tool set and list of supported platforms is sprawling, and some days the to-do list is longer than you'd like. If you can stay warm under pressure, create order out of chaos, learn new stuff fast because you love it, and speak up when you need help, you'll thrive here. If you need a rigid, fully-documented, never-changes environment where nobody trusts you with admin access, where you will be micro-managed so you never have to wonder whether or not you’re doing the right thing, this isn't it. You’ll have a ton of independence on our team, and freedom to use your best judgment to get the ball over the finish line, but that also means we expect you to be naturally responsible, honest, and highly accountable — to yourself, your teammates, and the clients. As they say, the price of freedom is eternal vigilance. The tech you'll work with (and grow into) Day one, you'll be living in: Apple at the core — macOS, iOS, Apple Business Manager, and MDM (Jamf / Iru / Intune / Workspace ONE / and more) Yes, PCs too — about one-third of our users are driving Windows Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 admin consoles Identity and access — SSO, MFA, and security keys (Okta, Entra ID, Yubikey, and friends) Lots of other security tools — our stack is constantly evolving and may vary from client to client The everyday productivity stack — Slack, Zoom, conference-room AV, networking basics (Meraki), and endpoint tooling ⠀ You don't need to know all of this. You need to be the kind of person who wants to. As you grow, there's a clear path into infrastructure administration, project architecture and implementation, and — for the right person — security and compliance work (phishing simulations, endpoint detection, SOC 2 / CIS / SEC readiness, due diligence questionnaire support, etc.). That's where our most senior people live, and it's wide open. Who we hope you are The hard requirements — we won't move forward unless you: Can work standard business hours in Eastern or Pacific time zones (we currently need both) Have a quiet home workspace and reliable broadband Have proven Apple aptitude — you actually use and like the Apple ecosystem Have at least 2 years of IT support experience on the job. Go-getters who are just getting started and can prove they have a deep, demonstrable history of teaching themselves technology for the sheer joy of it might also make the cut. ⠀ Everything else — and this is the longer list, on purpose. We figure technical skills are teachable; character takes a lot longer. So we're looking for someone who: Genuinely cares — about clients, teammates, and doing right by people Loves to learn, and proves it in how they spend their time Reads, and writes clearly — clear writing is clear thinking, and you'll do a lot of it Stays calm and kind with a frustrated person on the other end of the line Can tell the difference between good customer service and fantastic customer service, and refuses to settle for the former Notices when something's being done inefficiently and fixes it (you may boast about it later, that’s fine) Proofreads their own work (yes, we noticed whether you proofread your application) Has a sense of humor, and doesn't take themselves too seriously Regarding AI Our company founder/CEO is headquartered in the Bay Area. We work with innovative, ambitious companies developing AI products. Our team members hold a range of opinions about whether AI is “good or bad” for humans, but at the end of the day, we embrace the plain fact that it is here, we must embrace it to evolve, and our clients increasingly depend on us to help them embrace it, too, to help them evolve and stay competitive. Our CEO's opinion: AI will not replace human labor any time soon; rather, AI is a new opportunity to either (a) get things done faster, or (b) get a much higher quality of output than before. If you’re an AI tinkerer, great! We want to hear how you’re using it and see your latest vibe project. If you’re allergic to AI or have no interest in learning new habits to work effectively with it, this is not the place for you. Compensation & logistics Base salary: For applicants closer to the junior side who are located in the USA, $50,000–$65,000/yr, depending on experience level and your local geographical price index. With experience, comp goes up from there. Genuinely experienced, more senior candidates can be slotted higher — let's talk. Applicants outside the USA will be compensated according to your local employment market. Type & location: Full-time, work from home, fully remote. Eastern or Pacific time zones. Benefits: Medical / dental / vision for the employee, 401(k) with employer contribution, 2 weeks of PTO annually to start, and a stipend for your home internet. How to apply The first step is really easy and only takes 10 minutes — no resume, no cover letter, no essays. Here's how: Take this online Culture Index assessment (about 10 minutes): We use it to screen for people whose natural wiring fits how our team works. If your profile lines up with what we're looking for, we'll reach out and ask you to complete a 60-minute TestGorilla assessment for critical thinking skills, send us your resume, and maybe a couple of other items. From there, we conduct between 2-4 video interviews. One of these might be a live technical assessment. If the Culture Index step feels like a strange way to start a job application — that's kind of the point. Remember the phrase Think Different? Ignition is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome and will consider all qualified applicants. Good luck in your search — and may the Force be with you! To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/ignition-inc-mac-msp-help-desk-guru-work-from-home

items.description: Data and Analytics At The Coca-Cola Company, we believe data is the foundation for creating personalized experiences and powering sustainable growth in today's digital-first world. As consumers engage with our brands in more connected ways than ever before, we are investing in advanced data and analytics platforms to unlock deeper insights, accelerate decision-making, and enable seamless innovation at scale. In this role as a Sr. Data Engineer - Integrations, you will drive the technical strategy and architecture for how data flows across our enterprise ecosystem. By leveraging your expert-level proficiency in Spark, Scala/Java development, and JVM-based engineering, you will design scalable data products. Core Responsibilities Architect and oversee enterprise-scale data integration pipelines and data products. Establish Medallion architecture patterns (Bronze, Silver, Gold) within Microsoft Fabric to ensure data quality, scalability, and reusability. Optimization: Act as the ultimate escalation point for complex Spark performance tuning. Deep-dive into Catalyst optimizer query plans, JVM memory profiling, and advanced partitioning strategies to resolve platform-wide bottlenecks and maximize cost efficiency. Complex Backend System Design: Lead the system design and architecture of highly available, REST-based microservices and APIs on the JVM, enabling seamless, low-latency interoperability between complex internal and external systems. Engineer modular, testable, and maintainable code applying functional programming principles and industry-best patterns for reliability and performance. Optimize workflows through data partitioning strategies, storage formats, and platform configurations to enable high-performance querying and cost efficiency. Engineering Excellence & Mentorship: Champion the "You Build It, You Run It" philosophy. Define the standards for functional programming and SOLID principles in Scala. Conduct architectural reviews, lead code quality initiatives, and mentor Grade 10 and junior engineers. CI/CD & Automation: Architect and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Maven, and SBT to automate testing, deployment, and configuration of data artifacts. Required Qualifications & Experience Expert Scala & JVM Architecture: Expert-level proficiency in Scala programming and JVM internals. Demonstrated ability to design concurrent, modular systems using advanced functional programming concepts. Advanced Spark Expertise (5+ years): Deep, hands-on experience building, debugging, and optimizing enterprise-grade distributed computing applications using Apache Spark (Scala preferred). Proven track record of solving complex data skew and memory management issues at scale. Data Architecture & Strategy: Extensive experience designing scalable data models (STAR, Vault, Tabular) and building out Medallion architectures for complex enterprise analytics and structured streaming applications. Backend & API Engineering: Proven experience architecting and scaling REST-based microservices and robust backend applications on the JVM. Synapse/Fabric Leadership (4-5+ years combined): Deep architectural experience transforming large data ecosystems using Azure Data Services (Synapse, Fabric, ADF, Azure Functions). DevOps & CI/CD Mastery: Proven ability to architect automated release cycles and infrastructure deployment. Hands-on expertise with Git, GitHub Actions, build tools (Maven/SBT), and configuring environments for parallel development. Delivery: Experience in Agile development (Scrum, lean techniques) and collaborating with global engineering teams. Location(s): Mexico City/Cities: Mexico Travel Required: 00% - 25% Relocation Provided: No Job Posting End Date: August 29, 2026 Our Purpose and Growth Culture: We are taking deliberate action to nurture an inclusive culture that is grounded in our company purpose, to refresh the world and make a difference. We act with a growth mindset, take an expansive approach to what's possible and believe in continuous learning to improve our business and ourselves. We focus on four key behaviors - curious, empowered, inclusive and agile - and value how we work as much as what we achieve. We believe that our culture is one of the reasons our company continues to thrive after 130+ years. Visit Our Purpose and Vision to learn more about these behaviors and how you can bring them to life in your next role at Coca-Cola. Annual Incentive Reference Value Percentage:15 Annual Incentive reference value is a market-based competitive value for your role. It falls in the middle of the range for your role, indicating performance at target.

items.description: Customer Support Headquarters: United States (Remote) Grafana Labs, the company behind the open observability cloud, is founded on the principles of open source, open standards, open ecosystems, and open culture. Grafana Cloud, our fully managed observability platform, is flexible and built for scale. With Grafana Cloud's actually useful AI, organizations can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data to move at the speed of their ambitions. Today, more than 35 million users and 7,000+ customers – including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce – trust Grafana Labs to ensure reliability of their applications and systems, resolve incidents quickly, and optimize their telemetry to reduce noise and cost. We are a 100% remote company with 1,600+ team members across 40+ countries, and we’re backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. The Opportunity: At Grafana Labs, we’re redefining what post-sales technical partnership looks like—and it starts with the Observability Architect . This is a role for deeply technical experts who are ready to step into strategic leadership with our most important customers. If you thrive at the intersection of systems thinking, architecture design, and customer impact—this is your stage. As an Observability Architect, you will be the technical owner of long-term customer success. You’ll architect and guide the implementation of complex observability solutions across a wide range of modern infrastructure and application environments. You’ll build strategic relationships with engineers, SREs, and architects—ensuring Grafana’s technology is not just deployed, but deeply embedded into mission-critical systems. Working hand-in-hand with our Engagement Managers, you’ll lead technical discovery, design, onboarding, and enablement—all with a focus on delivering tangible outcomes. You’ll spot patterns, solve hard problems, and guide customers through their observability maturity curve with authority and clarity. You’ll also represent the technical voice of our customers internally—shaping product feedback and roadmap priorities by working closely with Engineering and Product Management. This is a hands-on, high-impact role for those who want to go deep, stay technical, and directly influence customer success at scale. Join us and become part of the most respected observability team in the industry. What You'll Be Doing: Serve as the primary technical point of contact for a portfolio of Grafana customers. Design the observability maturity journey of customers and assist them on that path. Provide expert-level troubleshooting and guidance to drive adoption. Conduct regular technical reviews and health checks to ensure client success. Assist in RCA to understand issues that affect customer satisfaction, retention, and overall product experience. Advise clients on best practices and strategies for leveraging our technology to achieve their business goals Collaborate with clients to develop and execute technical roadmaps. Identify opportunities for clients to optimize their cost, expand their use of our solutions and drive adoption of new products and features. Develop and maintain strong, long-term relationships with key stakeholders. With the support of our Engagement Managers and Onboarding Solutions Architects, own customer lifecycle. Drive the adoption and effective use of our product suite within your customer portfolio to maximize their value from our platform and ensure a strong return on investment. Act as the voice of the customer within the company, advocating for their needs, priorities and feature requests. Conduct training sessions and workshops to educate clients on our technology. Develop and deliver technical documentation, guides, and tutorials. Work alongside account teams to participate in and/or conduct regular reviews with customers to identify areas for improvement, calculate ROI, assess their satisfaction, and discuss upcoming needs and projects. Prepare and present reports on client metrics, achievements, and areas of focus. What Makes You a Great Fit: Located on the East Coast Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Math or a related field (or equivalent experience). Experience deploying and operating Kubernetes. 5+ years of experience in a technical support, technical account management, consulting, SE or Professional Services role within the technology industry. Strong understanding of observability solutions. Grafana, Prometheus, and Loki a plus. Proven ability to manage multiple clients and projects simultaneously. Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills. Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills. Experience with relevant tools and technologies, e.g., CRM software, ticketing systems, specific programming languages. Ability to travel as needed to meet with clients (up to 25%). Identify and provide timely workarounds and solutions to meet a customer’s business needs. You have some observability expertise, preferably architect level First class written and oral communication skills to collaborate with our remote-first internal teams and with our worldwide customers. Ability to articulate our value proposition and the technical advantages of our products You will love solving technical challenges and thrive on bringing creative solutions to our customers Bonus Points For: 2+ years of technical sales, TAM or other post sales technical experience, ideally with open source technologies, or in the observability space. Great at connecting product usage to value (ROI). Great at managing customer lifecycle. You will be creative in solving customer adoption challenges. You can proactively assist customers with technical issues that may arise and assist in the troubleshooting and root cause analysis. You should have a technical mindset and a desire to grow technically. Great candidates may be a recent grad of a coding bootcamp or have previous post-sales or engineering experience–we are excited to see what unique experiences and skill sets you bring to the table! In the US, the OTE compensation range for this role is $139,000 - $167,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally. *Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process. Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs: 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose. Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment. Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates. Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things. Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work. Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics. Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career. Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human. Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do. In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable. Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow. Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings. #LI-Remote For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy . To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/grafana-labs-associate-observability-architect-est-remote

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote, New Jersey URL: http://betmgm.com Discover What’s Possible at BetMGM Ready to make your career legendary? We’re a brand with technology at our hearts and the most driven and focused talent in the business. As a valued team member, we’re committed to giving you the resources and support you need to thrive. Our benefits and perks include: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, and Disability Insurance 401(k) with company match Pre-tax spending accounts including health care FSA and commuter savings Flexible paid time off Professional development reimbursement and ongoing skills training opportunities Employee resource groups Swag, ticket giveaways, and more! At BetMGM, we recognize that every individual plays a meaningful role in our success. That’s why we’re committed to building a respectful, inclusive workplace. It’s the strategy behind every win. By meeting people where they are, we create a culture of belonging where everyone can thrive and a workplace that reflects our values, our people, and our drive to win. The Gaming Marketing & Events Manager is a critical, highly visible role that serves as a linchpin between BetMGM’s digital gaming organization and MGM Resorts International’s land‑based casino portfolio. The role is responsible for ensuring seamless alignment between online and retail gaming experiences by positioning and promoting BetMGM (MI) /Borgata Online (NJ) brands effectively across MGM properties with a focus on MGM Grand Detroit & Borgata Hotel, Casino & Spa. Location: Must be located in NJ or Detroit, MI About the Role The Gaming Marketing & Events Manager is a critical, highly visible role that serves as a linchpin between BetMGM’s digital gaming organization and MGM Resorts International’s land‑based casino portfolio. The role is responsible for ensuring seamless alignment between online and retail gaming experiences by positioning and promoting BetMGM (MI) /Borgata Online (NJ) brands effectively across MGM properties with a focus on MGM Grand Detroit & Borgata Hotel, Casino & Spa. Responsibilities Acting as one of the primary points of contact for MGM, the Gaming Marketing & Events Manager will work alongside the Sr. Manager in strategy, execution, and optimization of integrated marketing initiatives which inspire existing land-based players to choose BetMGM (MI) /Borgata Online (NJ) as their preferred online gaming destination. This individual will play a key role in strengthening brand awareness, customer conversion, and long-term loyalty across our physical and digital channels . In addition, the Gaming Marketing & Events Manager will lead and oversee gaming event/activation execution. Some examples this includes are on-property Big Pull events, VIP experience weekends with MGMAir & co-branded digital-to-retail campaigns that drive player acquisition and engagement through Betting Hero. The role will partner closely with MGM marketing and special events teams, to ensure cohesive brand representation and seamless execution and guest experience. The ideal candidate w ill be an experienced gaming expert with a land-based casino events/marketing background who is passionate about the industry. Strong communication and organizational skills are essential, along with the ability to work effectively with many other key stakeholders located across both BetMGM and MGM Resorts International. Manage relationships between the BetMGM (MI)/Borgata Online (NJ) gaming teams and our land-based estate of MGM properties, with the principal goal of ensuring our BetMGM (MI)/Borgata Online (NJ) gaming labels are well advertised and presented within the properties. Timely support, regular communications, and prompt assistance with issues will all be commonplace. Partner with MGM Property Special Events and Marketing teams to support balanced brand placements, on-property activations, and promotional visibility aligned with internal campaign calendars. Serve as a day-to-day liaison between property teams (event operations and digital/physical signage) for BetMGM (MI) /Borgata Online (NJ) to coordinate logistics, staffing, promotional materials, and compliance requirements. Oversee and provide day-to-day direction to the BetMGM (MI) /Borgata Online (NJ) gaming events/marketing team, guiding planning timelines, task prioritization, vendor coordination, and on-site execution to ensure successful delivery of all casino-related events and on-site activations. Leverage the MGM Property Special Events calendar to see where omni-channel opportunities are possible to stand up. Oversee and provide day-to-day direction to the gaming events/marketing team, guiding planning timelines, task prioritization, vendor coordination, and on-site execution to ensure successful delivery of all gaming-related events and activations. Plan, coordinate, and execute gaming-related property events, including tournaments, promotional activations, VIP experiences, and brand showcases. Ensure events are delivered on time, on budget, and aligned with brand standards. Maintain and manage a property-level gaming event calendar, ensuring alignment with marketing campaigns, seasonal initiatives, and corporate objectives. Serve as a day-to-day liaison between property teams, event operations, and BetMGM (MI)/Borgata Online (NJ) gaming events/marketing team to coordinate logistics, staffing, promotional materials, and compliance requirements. Support on-site event execution as needed, including betting hero support, vendor coordination, event setup, compliance, signage placement and troubleshooting. Partner with the Business Intelligence team to analyze campaign and event performance, tracking KPIs such as attendance, new player acquisition, engagement, and ROI. Provide recommendations for improvement based on findings. Collaborate with the CRM and Loyalty teams to support targeted communications for property-based campaigns and event promotions, ensuring messaging is timely and performance-driven. Conduct competitive research on omnichannel gaming and property-based event strategies to identify trends, promotional mechanics, and opportunities for differentiation. Essential Functions Must be able to stand or sit and operate computers and other technological devices for extended periods of time. Ability to obtain and maintain a gaming license in applicable jurisdictions as a condition of hire and continued employment. Willingness and ability to travel regularly to MGM Grand Detroit & Borgata Hotel, Casino & Spa MGM properties to support planning meetings, team oversight, and on-site event execution, including evenings and weekends as business needs require. Qualifications 3+ years of experience in gaming, marketing, event management, hospitality, or related industry, with demonstrated ownership of live event execution. Willingness and ability to travel regularly to east coast regional MGM properties to support planning meetings, team oversight, and on-site event execution, including evenings and weekends as business needs require. Proven experience leading or directing an events team, providing day-to-day guidance, setting priorities, and ensuring accountability across planning and execution phases. Demonstrated success executing live events and on-property activations, including vendor coordination, cross-functional alignment, budget management, and real-time problem-solving. Experience collaborating across multiple departments (marketing, operations, VIP services, hospitality, and property leadership) to deliver integrated campaigns and seamless guest experiences. Knowledge of online and land-based casino operations is preferred, with understanding of regulatory considerations in highly controlled environments. Familiarity with regional MGM Resorts properties and/or BetMGM’s product ecosystem preferred. Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple large-scale initiatives simultaneously while balancing regional priorities. Strong commercial acumen with experience analyzing performance data, presenting insights clearly, and translating findings into actionable strategies. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at multiple levels. Strong analytical skills with high attention to detail and a proactive, solution-oriented mindset. The annual salary range for this position is $100000 to $125000. Factors which may affect starting pay within this range may include geography/market, skills, education, experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate. This position is also eligible for participation in a performance-based bonus plan. Applicants must possess legal authorization to work for our company in the U.S. without the need for immigration sponsorship. At this time, this role is not eligible for immigration-related employment authorization sponsorship including H-1B, O-1, E-3, TN, OPT, etc. Gaming Compliance & Licensing Requirements As an online gaming company, BetMGM is required to comply with state gaming regulations which includes licensing obligations. Applicable employees must be licensed by at least one jurisdictional agency, although certain positions require licensing by multiple agencies. Failure to become licensed or maintain licensure with each agency as required for the role may result in termination of employment. Please note that the licensing process includes comprehensive background checks which may include a review of criminal records, financial history, and personal background verification. In addition, candidates must comply with and support BetMGM's responsible gambling policies, procedures, and initiatives. About BetMGM BetMGM is revolutionizing sports betting and online gaming in the United States and Canada. We are a partnership between two powerhouse organizations—MGM Resorts International and Entain Group. You know our name through our exciting portfolio of brands including BetMGM Casino, BetMGM Sportsbook, Borgata Online, Party Casino and Party Poker. We aim to bring our ideas into action and find ways to deliver the best quality in gaming platforms. BetMGM LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified individuals, regardless of race, religion, gender, gender identity, age, marital status, national origin, sexual orientation, citizenship status, veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status. As an organization, we are unwavering in our commitment to maintaining a discrimination-free work environment, and fostering a culture of inclusivity, belonging and equal opportunity for all employees and applicants. If you need assistance or accommodation with your application due to a disability, you may contact us at recruitment@betmgm.com. This job description is not an exclusive or exhaustive list of duties a person in this position may be asked to perform from time to time. #LI-JM1 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/betmgm-gaming-marketing-and-events-manager

We are a 100% remote company with 1,600+ team members across 40+ countries, and we’re backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. The Opportunity Grafana's Demand Generation team is responsible for creating and accelerating pipeline across the full customer journey — from first touch through expansion. We run a modern, AI-forward operation: lifecycle email programs driven by an AI engine, territory-level buying signals surfaced directly to sales leaders, and agentic workflows that handle work that used to take teams of specialists. We're hiring a Demand Generation Program Manager — a generalist who can own programs across channels and audiences, with a first focus on our existing-customer motion: driving expansion and cross-sell demand within accounts that already use Grafana. This is one of the biggest growth opportunities in the business and one of the least-covered by traditional demand gen. This is not a "run the playbook" role. We expect this person to build with AI as a default — designing agentic workflows that scale programs beyond what headcount alone could, and pushing the team forward on how demand gen should operate in 2026 and beyond. You'd be joining a demand gen team that is genuinely rebuilding how the function works — where AI agents run real production programs, and where the people on the team design the machine rather than turn the crank. If you want to define what a demand gen career looks like in the agentic era, this is the seat to do it from. What You'll Be Doing Own customer lifecycle demand gen. Build and run programs that create demand inside our existing customer base — expansion, cross-sell, and adoption plays across email, in-app, web, and field channels, in partnership with sales and customer teams. Work across channels, not in one. Support and strengthen programs across paid, email, events, web, and outbound as team priorities shift. You'll be the person who can step into any channel and make the program better. Build agentic workflows.
