items.description: Design Headquarters: Chicago, SEA, SF, NYC, US-Remote Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. About the team As Stripe continues to develop innovative products that serve businesses of all sizes, risk will increase in complexity and scale. The Industry Expansion Strategy team protects Stripe's business and mission by building the policies, frameworks, and practices that enable Stripe to support businesses in complex, highly regulated industries. As Stripe expands into new markets and products, we unlock revenue, advance trust, and set the standard for what responsible growth looks like at scale. What you’ll do Stripe's financial infrastructure only works if merchants can trust it—and that trust depends on us staying ahead of card network requirements. The Industry Expansion Strategy team owns that problem globally. As part of the team, you'll be the person who ensures our merchant portfolio stays compliant with Visa, Mastercard, and other card network rules as Stripe scales globally. This isn't a passive monitoring role. You'll work directly with Sales, merchants, card networks, and internal Risk and Compliance teams to catch issues early, fix them fast, and build processes that move Stripe ahead. We are looking for someone who is passionate about navigating ambiguity, enabling business growth while balancing risk, and is skilled at identifying ways to improve user experience. Responsibilities Own oversight of merchant risk management processes for Payment Facilitators, Marketplaces, and other Third-Party Agents and Servicers, including preparing merchants for card network registration, managing network reporting requirements, and conducting periodic reviews and user remediations Partner with internal teams to design compliance strategies that support Stripe's global expansion without creating major downstream risks Embed within first-line teams, particularly Sales and Product, to train sellers to develop the judgment to catch gaps and position Risk as a business enabler Build new processes and enhance existing processes to optimize for efficiency and automation, manage incoming non-compliance escalations from partners, and monitor our portfolio against rules and requirements Perform research and analysis to assess Stripe's current market position and develop and prioritize long-term strategic plans for future growth Challenge the status quo and provide multiple alternative solutions and key execution criteria Execute special projects and ad hoc analyses as initiatives, products, risks, and opportunities are constantly evolving Who you are We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. Minimum requirements 5+ years of professional experience in a related role in Payments or FinTech industries, including experience with card network compliance Familiarity with banking and money movement regulations, including KYC and KYB, AML OFAC compliance, and credit and fraud risk Experience overseeing design execution and delivery of highly strategic programs Proven ability to take complex issues and turn them into actionable next steps, hold others accountable, and meet deadlines Data-driven problem-solving skills, including the ability to distill complex, ambiguous regulatory issues into clear, concise, and reliable guidance for stakeholders and Stripe users Demonstrated track record of deriving insights from complex or technical problem spaces and evangelizing actionable product recommendations Strong stakeholder management skills and operating rigor, including the ability to take ownership, be accountable, and lead without formal authority to navigate ambiguity and solve problems with the end user in mind Entrepreneurial and curious mindset, including motivation to develop deep subject matter expertise and understanding of risk-based frameworks Strong operating rigor, executive presence, and presentation skills, including experience engaging with leadership Experience in a client-facing role managing relationships with large, global organizations Preferred Qualifications Strong desire to work in a fast-paced and innovative environment A strong understanding of Stripe's business and products and an ability to research and self-start To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/stripe-risk-strategist-card-network-compliance

items.title: Lead Creative Strategist (Performance Marketing)
items.summary: Superside is hiring a Creative Strategist, Performance Marketing to lead the strategic thinking behind our clients' highest-volume, highest-velocity creative programs. You'll sit at the intersection of data and creative, turning performance signals from paid social, OOH, and programmatic campaigns into sharp, testable creative direction — while acting as a trusted strategic partner to the clients whose business results depend on it. You'll run strategy across a portfolio of accounts at once, each producing a high volume of creative every month, and you'll be the person both the client and the creative team turn to when they need to know not just what to make next, but why.

items.title: Brand Protection & Marketplace Compliance Analyst
items.summary: Position Type : Full-time Location: Philippines (Remote) Schedule: Mon-Fri, EST About the Company Our client is a global leader in swimming pool technology, specializing in robotic pool cleaners, pool safety products, water treatment solutions, and related pool equipment for residential and commercial customers. With a strong international presence and a network of distributors, subsidiaries, and partners across multiple markets, our client serves customers worldwide through a variety of sales and distribution channels. About the Role Our client is looking for a Brand Protection & Marketplace Compliance Analyst to monitor online marketplaces and digital channels across North America and Europe. The role focuses on identifying unauthorized sellers, marketplace and distribution violations, misuse of brand assets, and other compliance issues. You will conduct online research, analyze seller and product data, maintain accurate records, and prepare reports that provide actionable insights to the business. Responsibilities Monitor Amazon, eBay, Walmart, BestBuy, Home Depot, AliExpress, Temu, and other major marketplaces. Research products and identify new or unauthorized sellers. Classify sellers and verify their authorization status. Identify MAP, distribution, territory, and marketplace compliance issues. Monitor unauthorized use of logos, images, trademarks, and product content. Collect evidence such as URLs, screenshots, seller information, and product details. Maintain accurate seller databases and internal records. Prepare daily reports and monthly Voice of Consumer reports. Build and maintain dashboards tracking brand-protection metrics. Identify opportunities to improve research and reporting processes. Competencies and Qualifications Must-Have 3+ years of experience in data analysis, online research, e-commerce, compliance, or a related field. Strong Excel skills, including pivot tables. Strong research, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Excellent attention to detail and data accuracy. Strong written English and reporting skills. Ability to work independently and follow SOPs. Familiarity with Amazon and other e-commerce marketplaces. Nice-to-Have Brand protection or marketplace compliance experience. Experience with PROWL, Helium 10, Salesforce, or similar tools. Knowledge of MAP, distribution, or channel compliance. Experience with dashboards and reporting. Experience using AI research and translation tools. Key Qualities Detail-oriented Analytical Investigative Highly organized What We Offer 100% Remote Work â Work from anywhere in the Philippines. Career Growth Opportunities â Gain hands-on experience, and continuous learning. Collaborative & Innovative Team â Work alongside skilled professionals who value excellence. Application Process We understand that searching for a new job can be challenging, and weâre here to support you every step of the way. Our goal is to make the process as transparent and respectful as possible. The interview process includes a Recruiter Interview, Client Interview, and Assessment. As part of the process, candidates complete a hands-on task during the technical interview. Throughout each stage, we keep you informed and provide feedback as quickly as possible, ensuring you feel valued and supported throughout your journey with us. items.title: Talent Acquisition Supervisor - NA & LATAM

Job Overview The Talent Attraction team at TE Connectivity ensures the end-to-end process of hiring the best talent across our global businesses. As the Supervisor, Talent Attraction Coordination, you will lead the…
items.description: At TE, you will unleash your potential working with people from diverse backgrounds and industries to create a safer, sustainable and more connected world. Job Overview The Talent Attraction team at TE Connectivity ensures the end-to-end process of hiring the best talent across our global businesses. As the Supervisor, Talent Attraction Coordination, you will lead the Talent Attraction Coordination team supporting LATAM and North America, ensuring operational excellence throughout the recruitment lifecycle. You will partner closely with Talent Attraction Partners, Hiring Managers, HR Services, and external vendors to deliver a seamless recruitment and onboarding experience while driving process standardization, service quality, and continuous improvement. This role is based in Mexico and is responsible for leading Talent Attraction Coordination operations across the LATAM and North America regions. General Activities: Lead, coach, and develop a team of Talent Attraction Coordinators supporting recruitment activities across LATAM and North America, ensuring high-quality service delivery and operational excellence. Conduct regular performance reviews, coaching sessions, and development planning to build a high-performing Talent Attraction Coordination team while fostering employee engagement and career growth. Oversee end-to-end recruitment coordination activities, including interview scheduling, management of Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) such as SuccessFactors and/or SmartRecruiters, utilization of ticketing platforms such as Zendesk for case management and service delivery, offer letter administration, documentation, and pre-onboarding activities while ensuring compliance with defined SLAs. Act as the primary escalation point for complex recruitment coordination issues, proactively resolving scheduling conflicts, stakeholder concerns, and operational challenges. Partner closely with Talent Attraction Partners, Hiring Managers, HR Business Partners, HR Services, and external vendors across the LATAM and North America regions to ensure an outstanding candidate and hiring manager experience. Monitor team workload, capacity planning, productivity, and service quality across the LATAM and North America regions to ensure efficient allocation of resources and timely delivery. Drive continuous improvement initiatives by identifying process gaps, implementing automation opportunities, standardizing best practices, and enhancing operational efficiency. Ensure data accuracy, compliance, and governance within the Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), preferably SuccessFactors and/or SmartRecruiters, while maintaining recruitment metrics, dashboards, and operational reporting to support business decision-making. Prepare, analyze, and present recruitment operations reports, dashboards, SLA performance, scheduling turnaround time, candidate experience metrics, offer processing timelines, and regional insights to Global Talent Acquisition leadership, identifying trends and providing actionable recommendations to improve operational efficiency and service excellence. Support regional and global Talent Attraction projects, process transformations, system implementations, and organizational initiatives. Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing team culture while promoting TE Connectivity's values and leadership expectations What your background should look like: Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field. 6–8 years of experience in Talent Acquisition Operations, Recruitment Coordination, HR Operations, or Shared Services, including prior experience leading or mentoring teams. Experience supporting recruitment operations across the LATAM and North America regions, with a strong understanding of regional recruitment practices, employment considerations, and stakeholder management. Strong people leadership skills with demonstrated experience coaching, developing, and motivating high-performing teams. Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to effectively partner with senior Hiring Managers, Talent Attraction Partners, HR leaders, and external vendors. Proven experience managing high-volume recruitment coordination within a global or multinational organization. Strong understanding of recruitment operations, interview scheduling, offer management, pre-onboarding, Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) such as SuccessFactors and/or SmartRecruiters, and ticketing platforms (e.g., Zendesk) used to manage recruitment operations and service delivery. Experience managing service delivery metrics, SLAs, operational dashboards, and continuous improvement initiatives in a shared services or Talent Acquisition environment. Experience preparing executive-level reports, dashboards, and presentations, with the ability to translate recruitment metrics into meaningful business insights for senior leadership. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to make data-driven decisions. Excellent organizational skills with the ability to prioritize multiple competing demands in a fast-paced environment. Strong communication and interpersonal skills with fluency in English. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Microsoft Teams. Experience working across multiple countries and cultures within a matrix organization is highly desirable. Demonstrates TE Connectivity's core values: Teamwork, Accountability, Innovation, Inclusion, and Integrity. #LI-Remote Location: México Competencies SET : Strategy, Execution, Talent (for managers) Values: Integrity, Accountability, Inclusion, Innovation, Teamwork

items.description: About Zscaler Zscaler accelerates digital transformation to ensure our customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. As an AI-forward enterprise , we are constantly pushing the envelope, leveraging the world’s largest security data lake to power our cloud-native Zero Trust Exchange platform. This innovation protects our customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Here, impact in your role matters more than title and trust is built on results. We say, impact over activity. We seek innovators who actively use AI to amplify their impact and who thrive in an environment where we leverage intelligent systems to stay ahead of evolving threats. We believe in transparency and value constructive, honest debate —we’re focused on getting to the best ideas, faster. We build high-performing teams that can make an impact quickly and with high quality. To do this, we are building a culture of execution centered on customer obsession , collaboration, ownership, and accountability. We value high-impact, high-accountability with a sense of urgency where you’re enabled to do your best work and embrace your potential. If you’re driven by purpose, thrive on solving complex challenges, and want to be part of the team that’s helping to secure the AI age, we invite you to bring your talents to Zscaler and help shape the future of cybersecurity. Role We are looking for a Director, Business Operations, Customer Success to join our team. This is a Remote role reporting to the Sr. Director, Strategy & Operations.. This role is critical to supporting the global Customer Success organization, with a primary focus on Customer Support, Technical Success, and Professional Services. You will help stand up and lead a newly created Business Operations function, establishing the operating model, team responsibilities, and business rhythms needed to support a growing post-sales organization. In this role, you will drive operational rigor across resource management, P&L management, planning, intake and prioritization, and executive business reviews, while partnering closely with Customer Success leadership and cross-functional stakeholders. What you’ll do (Role Expectations) Establish and lead the Business Operations function for Customer Success, defining clear roles, responsibilities, and operating mechanisms to support Support, Technical Success, and Professional Services Own and evolve the operating cadence for the business, including Monthly Business Reviews, Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), Annual Operating Planning (AOP), and executive performance reviews Partner with Finance and Customer Success leadership to streamline resource management, capacity planning, investment prioritization, and P&L management across the post-sales organization Drive headcount planning, budget visibility, and investment tracking to help leaders make sound, data-driven business decisions Build and operationalize key KPIs, dashboards, and performance insights that provide visibility into business health, team performance, and operational efficiency in partnership with cross-functional teams Who You Are (Success Profile) You thrive in ambiguity and are comfortable building the path as you walk it in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity as the raw material to build something meaningful. You act like an owner with a passion for the mission that fuels your bias for action, operating with integrity and balancing strategic leadership with practical execution. You are a problem-solver who runs toward challenges and is energized by building structure, discipline, and solutions where they do not yet exist. You are a learner with a growth mindset, actively seeking feedback and continuously improving yourself, your team, and the way the business operates. You are a high-trust collaborator who builds strong partnerships through clarity, candor, and follow-through. What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications) Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving 8+ years of experience in Business Operations within post-sales functions such as Professional Services, Customer Success, or Customer Support Experience leading teams and developing high-performing individuals in operational or business management environments Experience building a new function, operating model, or business process in a growing or evolving organization Strong experience with planning, resource management, P&L management, KPI development, executive reviews, and operating cadences Strong understanding of the customer journey and the operational needs of post-sales organizations in a high-growth B2B SaaS or technology environment What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications) Experience applying AI, automation, or advanced analytics to improve operational efficiency, business visibility, and customer outcomes within post-sales organizations Experience partnering closely with Finance on budget management, headcount planning, and business performance reviews Experience establishing or scaling monthly business reviews, QBRs, and AOP processes across multiple post-sales functions #LI-remote #LI-NH1 Zscaler’s salary ranges are benchmarked and are determined by role and level. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations and could be higher or lower based on a multitude of factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. The base salary range listed for this full-time position excludes commission/ bonus/ equity (if applicable) + benefits. Base Pay Range $175,000—$250,000 USD At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with. We foster an inclusive environment that values all backgrounds and perspectives, emphasizing collaboration and belonging. Join us in our mission to make doing business seamless and secure. Our Benefits program is one of the most important ways we support our employees. Zscaler proudly offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families throughout their life stages, including: Various health plans Time off plans for vacation and sick time Parental leave options Retirement options Education reimbursement In-office perks, and more! Learn more about Zscaler's hybrid working model and benefits here . By applying for this role, you adhere to applicable laws, regulations, and Zscaler policies, including those related to security and privacy standards and guidelines. Zscaler is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals. We strive to create a workplace where employees are treated with respect and have the chance to succeed. items.description: About Securly Securly is the K-12 market leader in AI-powered student safety and wellness solutions, protecting more than 20 million students across 20,000+ schools. Our mission is to create safer, more supportive learning environments by detecting potential harm, supporting student mental health, and empowering educators with actionable insights that help students thrive. By turning data into meaningful, actionable intelligence, Securly enables schools to identify risk earlier, reduce harmful incidents, and strengthen student support — driving measurable improvements in safety and wellbeing. We're proud to be recognized as a Top Place to Work , named to TIME's America's Top EdTech Companies 2026 list, a Top 40 Most Used EdTech , and one of the 150 most transformational growth companies. The Role Securly is looking for a Director, Customer Success Operations to lead the systems, processes, and people behind our entire post-sale customer journey. You'll lead our CS Ops and Renewals function - a CS Ops Manager, a CS Ops Specialist, and a team of Renewals Specialists - and own Vitally, our Customer Success platform, as the operational backbone of the business. This is a builder's role. Vitally has been live for about a year, and the next chapter is yours to write: deepening adoption, sharpening health scoring, automating renewals workflows, and turning good instincts into a repeatable, data-driven system that scales. You'll be the operational thought partner to CS executives - using data and process design to make sure customer growth and success directly fuel Securly's growth. Location: Remote (U.S.) Type: Full-Time, Exempt Reports to: SVP, Customer Success What Success Looks Like In your first 90 days, you'll get under the hood - auditing our Vitally configuration, current CS Ops and renewals workflows, and team structure. You'll build real relationships with your team and ship your first wave of improvements: sharper health scoring, better dashboards, and a more programmatic renewals process. By 6 months, you're driving measurable gains - better renewals efficiency, stronger forecast accuracy, and dashboards that CS and company leadership actually rely on to run the business. By your first year, you own a mature CS Ops and Renewals function that consistently meets or exceeds retention targets, backed by a trained, accountable team and a Vitally instance that scales with Securly's growth. What You'll Do Lead the team Hire, coach, and manage a team of a CS Ops Manager, a CS Ops Specialist, and Renewals Specialists - setting clear goals and holding the team accountable to them Structure team capacity and coverage to match renewal volume and customer segmentation Build a real growth path for your team, from onboarding through career development Own the process Design, implement, and continuously refine scalable playbooks that support the entire post-sale customer journey Own the end-to-end renewal process - timely, accurate, and built to minimize churn Design and run a programmatic renewals process suited to a high-volume, complex customer base Turn data into decisions Own customer health scoring, tracking, and measurement across the install base Define and build the dashboards CS and executive leadership use to manage the business Surface customer insights to Product, Support, and Sales to drive real improvements Build the tech stack Serve as the internal owner of Vitally - driving adoption, configuration, and continuous optimization Identify, build, and implement Agentic AI and automation that genuinely moves the needle on CS Ops and renewals outcomes Manage the broader tech stack, including integrations with Salesforce and other GTM systems What We're Looking For 3+ years leading a Customer Success Operations, Revenue Operations, or Renewals team - this is a leadership track record, not an individual-contributor background, with proven experience scaling CS tools, systems, and AI Real examples of scaling a CS Ops function - taking a team, process, or system from early-stage to measurably better performance, with strong examples of building tools, systems, and process, and applying AI Hands-on experience building tech, systems, and automation - you've architected workflows, integrations, or automation inside a CS platform (Vitally, Gainsight, Totango, ChurnZero, or similar) and a CRM like Salesforce or HubSpot, not just used tools someone else set up Applied experience with Agentic AI and automation - you've actually built or implemented AI-driven workflows (like automated health scoring or renewals triage), not just explored the space A track record of building and coaching a team, with strong data analytics skills and fluency in core SaaS metrics (GRR, NRR, churn, CLV, NPS, CSAT) Strong project management skills and the ability to manage multiple cross-functional initiatives at once Experience in K-12, EdTech, or education-adjacent SaaS is a strong plus Why You'll Love Working at Securly Meaningful impact - build the operational engine behind a company that helps protect millions of students People-first culture - consistently recognized as a Top Place to Work Remote-first flexibility - work from home with a supportive, distributed team Real ownership - shape a growing platform and team, not maintain someone else's system Mission-driven work - what you build directly supports student safety and wellbeing Benefits & Perks Competitive salary up to $165K with performance incentives Medical, dental, and vision coverage 401(k) with employer match 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave Unlimited PTO, paid holidays, and a paid one-week year-end shutdown $1,000 annual professional development stipend Free mental health resources and Employee Assistance Program Equal Opportunity Employer Securly is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other legally protected characteristic. Accommodations are available throughout the hiring process - just let us know at recruitment.us@securly.com #LI-Remote #LI-DO1

items.summary: We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process!
items.description: We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process! About the role The CFO’s mission is to continue building upon Grüns ' already strong finance and data function — evolving it into a best-in-class engine that empowers the entire organization to make faster, smarter decisions. Leading a team of three strong leaders, this role is about leading the strong teams below them to democratize financial intelligence across the Grüns organization: self-serve dashboards, on-demand reporting, and real-time visibility that puts decision-making power in the hands of every team member. The CFO is a relentless, collaborative business partner, never satisfied with where the business is on revenue scale or profitability, always pushing for the next point of EBITDA margin improvement across all functions and driving efficiency to fuel continued revenue growth. They will ensure Grüns scales with confidence while meeting all external requirements seamlessly in the background. This role is part of our remote HQ! We have a fully remote, high-trust work environment - and also come together on a biannual basis for amazing off-sites where we can connect IRL. What success looks like: If we look ahead a year from now, the right person in this role would have: Leveraged what we’ve built so far, found areas for improvement, and fully operationalized a goal accountability framework that keeps business initiatives tied to financial outcomes, ensuring the leadership team is consistently tracking toward revenue and profitability targets. Driven meaningful EBITDA margin improvement across all functions and improved LTV:CAC efficiency to fuel continued revenue growth. Delivered self-serve dashboards, templatized reporting, and real-time P&L visibility across functions so every team has the data access they need without relying on ad-hoc requests. Business decisions are democratized and exponentially quicker. Created the conditions for a high-performing, motivated team empowering vs. micromanaging, actively developing leaders, and driving strong results and performance without burnout. Built the systems and processes to meet all external reporting and compliance requirements seamlessly, keeping the team focused on growth. We're looking for someone with: Relentless Growth Mindset: Always asking what it takes to get to the next level, whether that's another point of margin, better efficiency, or a faster path to revenue growth - a genuine internal drive to make the business the best it can be. Finding new opportunities across the business and proposing these opportunities to the CEO and functional leads. Integrity and Business-First Thinking: Prioritizes the truth over “looking good”. Navigates competing stakeholder interests honestly and thoroughly rather than taking the path of least resistance. Empowering Leadership: Leads by giving people the tools, clarity, and confidence to make great decisions vs. controlling the work directly. Actively develops their functional leaders, makes their team better than they were before. Drives sustainable high performance. Paper Wall Pusher: Treats perceived constraints as hypotheses, not facts. When told something takes six weeks or "this is how it's done," they ask why and push for faster, smarter, or different. Actively hunts for process bloat and inherited ways of working to find improvements. AI-Native Operator: Uses AI natively in their own workflow and actively builds AI fluency into the team's operating model. Sees AI as a core lever for scaling the function's impact without scaling headcount. Direct, but kind: Direct and honest in every conversation, saying what needs to be said, even when it's uncomfortable. Deeply committed to the business and the people in it. Experience: 10+ years leadership experience in a high-growth, profitable businesses; some level of physical inventory experience (CPG, retail, e-commerce, or similar) is a must Experience leading the functions in scope - finance, accounting, data, and BizOps functions Experience within a high-growth company that is adapting to public company practices Compensation & Benefits: At Grüns , we're committed to providing a competitive total compensation package — grounded in market data that considers our size, stage, industry, and location. For this role, the base salary is $350,000 + incentive compensation, paired with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and growth of our team. A bit about us... At Grüns , we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. We're dedicated to bringing comprehensive and real nutrition to you through our gummies, formulated from 60 nutrient-dense and whole-food ingredients. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you. Like you, we were disappointed. There’s an infinite number of “nutrition” companies, all focused on what’s best for them — not what’s best for you. Hundreds of products to sell you on, low-quality ingredients, and small nutrient doses. We’ve seen it all. So we decided it was time to fix it. No more choking on and popping pills like a pharmacy. No more clean-up and disgust from gross powders. And no more cobbling together handfuls to dozens of supplements. Grüns is comprehensive nutrition, made convenient and delicious. What we care about... Be the Best: We hold ourselves, our teams, and our partners to an incredibly high standard - and we raise the bar constantly. "We've never done this before" isn't an excuse here. It's an invitation. Own It: We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners. Drive Impact, Urgently: We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most. Compensation & Perks: For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth. Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. We have super strong benefits coverage -- for you and your family, generous PTO, free Grüns subscriptions, and a few more perks centered around health and well-being that we can't wait to tell you about! items.title: PnP Pipeline On-call Support Engineer
items.summary: Role SummaryYour primary mission is to ensure the consistent health and stability of our PnP (Power and Performance) pipelines.
items.description: Role Summary Your primary mission is to ensure the consistent health and stability of our PnP (Power and Performance) pipelines. You will serve as the first line of defense, monitoring pipelines and performing initial triaging to reduce manual overhead for our engineering teams. This role is critical to maintaining the velocity of our post-silicon PnP work as we scale. Core Responsibilities Pipeline Monitoring: Conduct regular, proactive health checks on functional and PnP-enabled flows. Ensure data integrity by verifying that test results are populating correctly on the RLS PnP dashboard. Initial Triage: Investigate pipeline failures and categorize them to streamline resolution: Infrastructure/Deployment Issues: CI pools, hargow issues, or platform environments (e.g., Artemis/Coleman HW/FW mismatches). UTF / PnP Analyzer Issues: Troubleshoot problems within the Unified Test Framework (UTF) or artifact deployment. Mature Pipeline Issues: Address issues specific to pipeline logic for stable flows that are no longer under active development. Resolution & Escalation: Perform bug fixes for straightforward issues (e.g., patching deployment or execution changes). For infrastructure issues, post to the appropriate internal channels for escalation and follow-up. Escalate complex or systemic issues to pipeline owners by providing necessary logs and context. Collaborate with pipeline owners and XFN (Cross-Functional) DRIs to ensure proper placement of PnP trace tags and alignment of measurement windows. Qualifications & Technical Requirements Core Requirements: Proven experience in monitoring alerts and dashboards. Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to identify patterns in failure logs and suggest improvements. Ability to differentiate between infrastructure, firmware, and analyzer-specific errors. Preferred Qualifications: Familiarity with jest-e2e and the Unified Test Framework (UTF). Experience working within internal infrastructure (e.g., buck, sandcastle, phabricator, internal AI tooling). Ability to read and interpret CI pipeline logs effectively. Ability to leverage AI tooling effectively (claude code, Metamate, etc.) Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Sr. Clinical Operations Manager
items.summary: About Carrot: Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life.
items.description: About Carrot: Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide. Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at . The Opportunity 🚀 This role serves as the operational backbone of the Global Clinical Operations (GCO) team, developing a deep understanding of GCO's day-to-day workings in order to help operationalize its running. You'll coordinate new projects, identify the right stakeholders, and partner closely with the GCO team, including GCO clinical leadership, to keep programs running smoothly. This is a hands-on operations role where success is measured by reliable execution, clean reporting, and strong cross-functional coordination. You'll be the connective tissue between GCO sub-teams and partners across product, commercial, GTM, and customer success, giving you visibility into how clinical operations decisions ripple across the business. What You’ll Own 💼 In this role, you will: Serve as the operations point person across GCO sub-teams, keeping frameworks, timelines, and ways of working consistent. Coordinate the GCO components of new projects end-to-end: identify stakeholders, track deliverables, and keep work moving across global clinical operations, product, and other partner teams. Track spend against program budgets, flagging variances to leadership. Spot and help close gaps or silos between GCO sub-teams by maintaining regular alignment touchpoints. Build and maintain dashboards and reporting infrastructure that give leadership real-time visibility into program status, trends, and open decisions. Pull together monthly operational updates, synthesizing data from Jira, Zendesk, Airtable, Salesforce, BI tools, and other program analytics into clear, actionable summaries. Help connect operational metrics to clinical and business outcomes so leadership has a clear line of sight from day-to-day activity to impact. Serve as a connector between GCO and commercial, GTM, and customer success teams, ensuring the right subject-matter expert is looped into RFPs, RFIs, and retention/expansion conversations. Ensure feedback from client-facing teams is incorporated into GCO program planning and prioritization. Identify opportunities to use AI tools, automation, and workflow improvements to save the team time and reduce manual work. Support team members in getting up to speed on new tools and best practices as they're introduced. What Success Looks Like 📈 In your first 12–18 months, you will have: Created and rolled out dashboards and reporting infrastructure that are adopted by GCO leadership.Improved operational efficiency across GCO, including reduced redundant meetings and streamlined recurring processes.Established a strong working rhythm with key GCO leadership and cross-functional partners. Successfully managed multiple projects concurrently, hitting key milestones and deadlines, with consistent reporting/status updates so stakeholders always know where each project stands. About You ✨ You likely have: A Bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, business, public health, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience in clinical/healthcare operations. Demonstrated, hands-on experience in scheduling, budgets, and cross-functional coordination within clinical operations. Strong program and process-design skills, shown through a program management certification or 2+ years of project management experience, including building/maintaining SOPs, governance documentation, and decision-informing reporting. High comfort level with modern productivity and data tools (Google Workspace, Slack, Jira, Salesforce, Airtable, BI dashboards) and the ability to quickly learn new systems, including AI-enabled tools. A demonstrated ability to operate across multiple fast-moving workstreams simultaneously without losing track of details. Strong documentation skills, with the ability to create and maintain clear, reusable, well-organized documentation. Extreme organization, with the ability to manage and maintain large databases and datasets accurately. The ability to establish a process and cadence for audits, ensuring data and documentation stay accurate and current over time. Nice to Have ⭐ While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring: Experience in reproductive and/or hormonal health (fertility, pregnancy, menopause, low testosterone, gender-affirming care) and related coverage/benefit policies. A track record of using data to drive decisions — defining KPIs, building dashboards, running monthly/quarterly operational reviews. Comfortable operating in high-growth, ambiguous environments with a bias toward scalable systems and automation. Why This Role Matters 🧡 This role sits at the center of Carrot's Global Clinical Operations function, translating day-to-day execution into the reporting and coordination that leadership relies on to make decisions. By keeping GCO's sub-teams aligned and connecting clinical operations to commercial and customer-facing teams, this person directly shapes how reliably Carrot delivers on its clinical programs — and how clearly that impact gets communicated across the business. Why Candidates Join Carrot 🌍 Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission. Highlights include: A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally. A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact. Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits. Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge. Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits. A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture. The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide. Compensation 💰 Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from$128,000.00 - $150,000.00. Actual compensation may vary from the posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience. Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: A Note on AI At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves. Why Carrot? Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Liquidity Operations Analyst
items.summary: Work with the bestWe are Orderly, the ultimate destination for decentralized trading platforms.
items.description: Work with the best We are Orderly, the ultimate destination for decentralized trading platforms. We are not satisfied with the limitations of centralized exchanges or the complexities of building decentralized order books. We aim to make trading easy, fast, and secure for everyone. How? By fusing the simplicity of CeFi with the power of DeFi. At the heart of the issue lies “liquidity”. Builders often grapple with a paradox; traders need liquidity, but liquidity demands traders. Our solution is simple as is bold –concentrate all liquidity into one order book. One order book that connects all the liquidity in the crypto space. Our ambition doesn't stop there. We're omnichain, championing chain abstraction. We envision seamless transactions, where the underlying blockchain is merely a detail. By concentrating liquidity, we aim to redefine the crypto landscape, making bridging and wrapped assets a thing of the past. We are Orderly, and we are here to revolutionize DeFi, democratizing access to financial opportunities and fostering a fair, equitable paradigm for all. A Glimpse into Your Future at Orderly Network What will you be working on? Process, clean, and validate liquidity and trading data to ensure accuracy and usability. Extract and transform trading data to generate regular reports (weekly/monthly) and support alerting mechanisms. Monitor liquidity dashboards and identify anomalies in a timely manner. Maintain and update market parameter configuration tables. Support market maker onboarding and assist with incentive distribution processes. Participate in data analysis for liquidity mechanism design and assist in testing new incentive models. Who will you be working with? Work closely with the liquidity operations team on daily monitoring and execution. Collaborate with product, trading, and data teams to ensure data accuracy and operational efficiency. Support coordination with market makers during onboarding and ongoing operations. What challenges will you face? Handling large volumes of trading data with high accuracy requirements. Identifying anomalies and ensuring data quality in a fast-moving trading environment. Balancing data processing, monitoring, and operational support tasks simultaneously. Adapting quickly to evolving liquidity strategies and incentive mechanisms. Interested in Learning More? Our hiring process begins by meeting with our People Team, who help facilitate the process of placing you in your new role. You can expect to share your experience and ideas in online video interviews with our hiring team, made up of management and potential new colleagues. If you have experience in developing trading systems or financial-related products is a plus. You can prepare for this interview by mentally organizing your strategies and opinions on topics such as Web3, cryptocurrency trading platforms, and your vision of how to succeed. Share this! Don’t be afraid of friends or co-workers stealing this job! If you are amazing and smart we will find a place for you. Check out our External Referral Incentives Program as well. We work in close collaboration with Global Corporate and Investment Bankers and Global Markets Sales to support the Bank's global regulatory and policy requirements as it relates Client Due Diligence (CDD) documentation collection, with support from Operations and Global Financial Crimes Risk teams. The team identifies and develops client connections, engages client representatives to obtain KYC documentation, and acts as a coordination point for resolving issues/challenges with respect to client and country specific documentation requirements in a timely manner. In addition to the ongoing document engagement, individuals within the team keep abreast of global regulatory change that could influence processes, and identify opportunities that enhance the client experience. The Role The KYC Client Outreach Change team oversee delivery of Front Line Unit (FLU) programs, process engineering, and tools and systems used by the FLU. mapping in Microsoft Visio Implement process design changes designed from analysis including creating training and procedural materials, performing readiness activities for process changes, and items.description: Data and Analytics Job Description: About us At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. Responsible Growth is how we run our company and how we deliver for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day. One of the keys to driving Responsible Growth is being a great place to work for our teammates around the world. We're devoted to being a diverse and inclusive workplace for everyone. We hire individuals with a broad range of backgrounds and experiences and invest heavily in our teammates and their families by offering competitive benefits to support their physical, emotional, and financial well-being. Bank of America believes both in the importance of working together and offering flexibility to our employees. We use a multi-faceted approach for flexibility, depending on the various roles in our organization. Working at Bank of America will give you a great career with opportunities to learn, grow and make an impact, along with the power to make a difference. Join us! Global Business Services Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations. Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation. In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services. Process Overview Global Financial Control India is the global delivery footprint of the bank's Global Financial Control function within the Chief Financial Officer group and is responsible for multiple functions including U.S.and Regional Legal Entity Controllership, Regulatory Reporting, Balance Sheet Reconciliations, Tax Accounting & Compliance, Treasury, Operational Risk & Controls Oversight, Finance Change, Production Services and Data Management. In short, our focus is to get the numbers right and to work in support of the company's goals, most importantly responsible growth. Job Description The role involves reporting, analysis, accounting, data validation and liaising with various stakeholders. Responsibilities Finance analyst position responsibilities will include any of the following: • Responsible for various day to day accounting processes, financial analysis, financial and management reporting • Accountable for application of financial principles, ability to read and comprehend financial reports and conduct & conclude analysis. • Responsible for data dictionaries/conformance to instructions and /or preparation of various regulatory reports, documentation, interpretation and communication of regulatory reporting requirements • Perform Legal Entity tax forecasts; review tax journal entries, tax account analysis and annual tax expense true-up & variance explanations. • Performing reconciliations of Balance Sheet accounts adhering to Account Reconciliation Policy (ARP) and Account Reconciliation Standards (ARS); investigate & report out any breaks. • Supporting in systems Implementation and enhancements • Responsible for executing changes to finance systems and ensuring all financial accounting & reporting systems and applications are operating smoothly from a functional perspective. • Ensuring adherence to financial data standards and quality of data • Support risk management, controls & compliance processes including risk performance monitoring & tracking, controls validation & reviews, SOX compliance, regulatory reports testing & attestation and reconciliation reviews. • Project work related to process improvement and automation of processes. • Supporting in project management and various team initiatives • Data collation and liaising with various stakeholders. • Stakeholder dealing, liaising with various teams. Requirements Education Chartered Accountant (CA) with 0 -2 years of experience Certifications If Any - NA Experience Range 0-2 years Foundational skills • Basic working knowledge of reporting, analysis, accounting and various finance functions • Ability to understand the financial statements • Fundamental understanding of risk management and internal controls • Excellent written and verbal communication skills. • Ability to effectively manage multiple priorities. • Able to work in a fast-paced environment. • Proficient in the use of Excel, Word and PowerPoint • Ability to assimilate large amounts of information quickly and to understand complex methodologies and issues. • Highly motivated, able to work independently, self-starter; and problem/solving/analytical. Desired skills • Knowledge of US GAAP accounting standards • Good knowledge of financial / banking products (derivatives, swaps, interest, bonds, credit, etc.) • Working knowledge of Oracle/SAP, SQL, Tableau, Alteryx, SharePoint would be preferred. Work Timings Between 7:00 AM - 10:30 PM (Standard shift is 9 Hrs, expectation to stretch during critical activity periods like Month Close) Job Location Mumbai/Gurugram

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Fully remote URL: https://www.testgorilla.com/ We’re looking for a hands-on Sales Manager to lead a dynamic team of 6–8 SMB Account Executives, who own the full sales cycle from the initial outreach to close. You’ll own the SMB number, build a high-performance culture where the best sellers thrive. This is a true player-coach role : the antithesis of a hands-off, dashboard-only manager job! You’ll be on calls with your team every day, jumping in to help them close, modelling the behaviours and standards you expect, and turning every deal into a coaching moment. When a deal is stuck, you get on the call. When a rep is struggling with a stage, you show them how it's done. You don't wait for things to go wrong - you're out ahead of it, making your team and the company better. You'll use Gong and HubSpot deeply to inspect pipeline, coach reps, and continuously raise the bar. If you love being in the trenches with reps, getting on live calls, and showing people exactly how to close, this role is the one for you. Responsibilities Lead a global team of 6-8 SMB Account Executives, owning their ramp, performance, career growth, and creating a team culture people want to be part of and recommend to others. Carry the team SMB quota, owning forecasting, pipeline health, and weekly, monthly, and quarterly results, using HubSpot deeply for pipeline inspection, sequence performance, and reporting. Run high-impact 1:1s, deal reviews, and pipeline reviews focused on specific behaviors, using Gong daily to identify coaching opportunities, codify what great looks like, and accelerate ramp. Be on a high-volume of live sales calls every week, joining discoveries, demos, and negotiations to support reps, model best practices, and step in to close when it matters. Think and deliver in an AI-first way, using tools like Claude and n8n to reduce admin, improve rep performance, and help the team adopt AI effectively. Build, maintain, and continuously improve the SMB sales playbook, including discovery frameworks, demo structure, objection handling, and closing motions. Partner with VP Sales, Marketing, GTM Operations, and Customer Success to drive consistent SMB pipeline and customer outcomes, train the team, and surface front-line insights back to Product and Leadership. What you’ll bring We're looking for someone who: Is passionate about TestGorilla's mission to help one billion people find their dream jobs. Has strong written and verbal communication skills in English. Thrives in a non-corporate, async-first, remote environment. Has experience managing SMB SaaS sales teams with a clear track record of hitting and exceeding quota, and a background as a top-performing closer before moving into management. Is a genuine player-coach: you actively want to be on live calls, jump into deals, and demonstrate how to close. Operates in a high-accountability environment: holding high standards for themselves and their team. Has deep, hands-on proficiency with Gong and HubSpot, including pipeline management, forecasting, deal stage discipline, call coaching, and reporting. Has strong coaching skills and a repeatable framework for developing reps with radical candor, plus experience hiring and ramping SMB closers in a high-velocity environment. Is very comfortable using AI tools, including Claude and n8n, and keen to help the team adopt them effectively. While we hire for skills over specific years of experience, we would generally expect that someone with the above skills has 3-5 years of Sales management experience. This is not a first-time manager role! We seek diversity and encourage applications from everyone. Studies show that women and underrepresented groups can be hesitant to apply unless they meet every requirement. If you're interested in this role but your experience doesn't perfectly match the description, please still apply. Bonus skills While this isn’t a requirement, we’d be very interested to hear from you if you have experience: Selling and managing teams in HR tech, ATS, recruitment, talent assessment, or recruiting software. Leading SMB teams in a product-led, PLG-influenced, or self-serve-to-sales motion. What’s in it for you? Please note: Some specifics, particularly around leave, may vary depending on your country of residence. This will be discussed during the hiring process. Global Team: Join a fully remote, mission-driven team from around the world Competitive compensation: Receive competitive pay (Total OTE of €120,000-€151,000 on a 50/50 base/variable split) and Share Appreciation Rights (SARs) Remote & flexible work: Work from almost anywhere*. Enjoy flexible hours and asynchronous work to balance work and life. * Check out the Countries we currently hire from here Remote work budget: €1,000 available each year or up to €2,000 from day 1 if you're buying a laptop! Growth & development: Invest in yourself and your career with a 3.5% L&D budget and clear growth opportunities Parent/Caregiver support: We provide a caregiver-friendly work environment with paid 8-16 week parental leave and tailored return-to-work approaches Work-life balance: Our unlimited and flexible time off policy empowers you to take the time you need to recharge and maintain your well-being To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/testgorilla-manager-smb-sales

Gusto is seeking retirement implementation specialists who thrive in a fast-paced, consultative environment and are interested in being considered for future start dates in 2026 . If you’d like to be considered for future opportunities with our team, please complete the form below and upload your resume. While start dates are still being determined for 2026, we’d love to connect! Does this sound like you? Apply below About the Role: The Implementation Specialist manages the end-to-end onboarding experience for 401(k) plans on the Gusto platform, spanning both new plan implementations and conversions from existing retirement plan providers. Depending on team assignment, this role guides plan sponsors and administrators through either a new plan setup or a full conversion lifecycle (from initial handoff through asset transfer, data reconciliation, and first contribution). The ideal candidate is proactive, organized, and experienced in client-facing implementation — comfortable managing a high-volume book of business, maintaining meticulous attention to detail, and confidently guiding employers through complex, multi-step processes. They work exclusively with plan sponsors and administrators and bring both operational rigor and a client-first mindset to every interaction. About the Team: The Retirement Onboarding team oversees two of the most consequential moments in a client's journey with Gusto 401(k): launching a brand-new plan and transitioning an existing one to a new provider. The New Plans pod designs a seamless implementation experience from day one, instilling trust and laying the foundation for long-term client success. The Conversion pod handles operationally complex asset transfers with precision, ensuring sponsors and administrators feel supported at every step and that assets move accurately and on time. Across both, we combine operational excellence with a client-first approach. Here's what you'll do day-to-day Manage a dedicated book of business of 401(k) plans — new enterprise/starter plans, conversion plans, or both — from signing through activation, asset transfer, and first contribution processing Serve as the primary point of contact for plan sponsors and administrators via email, phone, and video — including inbound scheduling through Calendly Guide employers through pre-ready task dashboards, proactively following up to prevent stalls and keep plans on track for their plan start date Monitor and drive performance against key benchmarks including time to activate, time to ready, CSAT, and average response time For conversion plans: gather required documentation, support accurate data submission, and partner with Operations to ensure smooth asset transfers and recordkeeping transitions Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Operations, and Legal to resolve setup and compliance issues and align on client expectations Surface client feedback to product and leadership to inform platform improvements, and stay current on 401(k) regulations and best practices Use AI tools to streamline workflows, improve client communications, and increase efficiency across your book of business Here's what we're looking for 4+ years of total work experience with 3+ years in client-facing implementation, account management, technical onboarding, or retirement plan administration; startup and/or financial services experience a plus Proven ability to manage a large, active book of business involving complex, multi-step processes simultaneously while staying organized and proactive across competing priorities Deep knowledge in one or more of the following: SaaS, Operations, or Finance; retirement plan experience strongly preferred; familiarity with 401(k) plans, ERISA requirements, payroll systems, bundled vs. unbundled providers, or Safe Harbor compliance is a plus Strong analytical skills and meticulous attention to detail, particularly around data accuracy and reconciliation Proficiency with Salesforce and comfort working across case management and collaboration tools in a fast-paced environment Strong communication skills across email, phone, and video with a client-first mindset Ability to identify and escalate potential setup or compliance issues early, partnering with the right internal teams to resolve them RPS or CRPS designation a plus, or active pursuit of either Gusto has physical office spaces in Denver, San Francisco, and New York City. Employees who are based in those locations will be expected to work from the office on designated days approximately 2-3 days per week (or more depending on role). The same office expectations apply to all Symmetry roles, Gusto's subsidiary, whose physical office is in Scottsdale. Note: The San Francisco office expectations encompass both the San Francisco and San Jose metro areas. When approved to work from a location other than a Gusto office, a secure, reliable, and consistent internet connection is required. This includes non-office days for hybrid employees. items.description: Product Headquarters: San Francisco, Seattle, NYC, Chicago, Atlanta, US Remote Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. About the team The Stripe Dashboard helps millions of people around the world run their business—from managing integrations and analyzing fraud to resolving customer issues. The next chapter is about transforming the Dashboard into a "power tool" for payment professionals. The Dashboard team is responsible for the scaffolding of the Dashboard (e.g., navigation, search, settings), governing frameworks (e.g., information architecture), and core experiences that set the standard (e.g., managing your customers, customizing your home page). We're hiring a product manager to shape the Dashboard strategy, amplify its impact across the company, and accelerate Stripe's mission to increase the GDP of the internet. What you'll do You'll evolve the Dashboard to meet the needs of any business model. Improve wayfinding mechanisms to increase user productivity and product discovery. Shape the information architecture to encourage interoperability. Develop a strategy and roadmap for a more personalized Dashboard. Write the playbook for interoperability across the numerous layers of indirection in the Dashboard. Partner with third-party developers to understand how the Dashboard can better serve their needs. Responsibilities Make the Dashboard easier to use and more powerful Own the strategy and roadmap that makes the Dashboard uniquely good for any business model Collaborate with engineering and design across time zones (PST, EST, CET) to ship high-impact functionality that delights users, product teams, and third-party developers Define and track success metrics for quality and performance Partner with senior leadership to understand and uphold our ambitions for quality at scale Who you are This role is equal parts systems thinking, storytelling, and data science. You thrive in horizontal roles that require intense collaboration and influence across product teams to achieve very difficult changes. We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. Minimum requirements 10+ years of experience in product management, design, or engineering with at least 3+ years in a senior capacity making company-level product decisions Strong understanding of user interface (UI) and user experience (UX) principles and best practices Technical familiarity with personalization systems, data modeling, and machine learning Strong written and verbal communication across business, design, and engineering audiences Demonstrated experience leading company-wide initiatives influencing technical roadmaps Preferred qualifications Believe that fast software is the best software Built complex personalization systems in the past Developed governance frameworks that balance usage and discovery Strong (informed) point of view on how third-party apps fit into first-party experiences Enjoy using social media to interact directly with customers for feedback To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/stripe-staff-product-manager-dashboard

As an Enterprise CSM, you will work closely with a large portfolio of enterprise-level government agency customers to develop comprehensive Account Plans that align with their long-term objectives. You will be responsible for monitoring customer health, driving product adoption, ensuring customer satisfaction, and facilitating customer loyalty at scale. This role offers a unique opportunity to collaborate with various internal teams, leverage CSM and Gov Tech industry best practices, and significantly impact our customers’ success. Accela provides a robust cloud-based platform of government software solutions that accelerate growth, efficiency, and transparency in communities of all sizes. Our customers are government agencies looking to improve citizen engagement, streamline processes, and enhance service delivery. By leveraging our platform, they can do more with less, providing consistent and convenient services to the public. Our Customer Success approach is built on establishing clear customer goals, driving adoption, ensuring value realization, fostering customer advocacy, managing relationships proactively, anticipating and solving potential issues, and continuously improving our strategies. By incorporating these principles, you will help create a seamless and valuable experience for our enterprise customers in the Gov Tech industry. RESPONSIBILITIES: Manage a large portfolio of enterprise government agency customers, delivering high-touch engagement and strategic guidance at scale. Build and maintain trusted advisor relationships with senior stakeholders and executive sponsors, includingCXO-level contacts on both the IT and business sides of the organization. Develop 3-5 year strategic agency plans in partnership with customers, aligned to Accela’s product roadmap and the agency’s long-term goals. Travel regularly to customer sites to conduct walk-the-halls engagement, strengthen relationships, and deepen organizational awareness. Own renewal health for the portfolio, proactively identifying and managing at-risk accounts, forecasting renewal outcomes, and driving retention through consistent value attainment. Partner closely with Sales to identify, develop, and advance upsell and cross-sell opportunities within the enterprise portfolio. Build and maintain KPI dashboards and deliver compelling data stories that communicate customer progress, outcomes, and Accela’s impact to both internal and customer stakeholders. Benchmark customer outcomes against industry peers and best practices, helping customers understand their performance and identify areas for improvement. Identify AI use cases specific to each customer’s workflows and track AI feature adoption as a key health and engagement signal. Leverage AI tools and capabilities to scale customer success activities across a large portfolio without sacrificing quality of engagement. Develop, implement, and track goals using the Objective and Key Results (OKR) framework. Advocate for customer needs within the organization through formal Voice of the Customer (VoC) processes, ensuring enterprise feedback directly influences product and service development. Flag competitive displacement risks at accounts and surface competitive intelligence to internal teams. Identify and develop peer reference opportunities and partner with Marketing to develop case studies that turn healthy accounts into advocates. Manage escalations end to end, owning the escalation path from intake through resolution. Mentor and provide informal leadership to CSM teammates, sharing enterprise best practices and success methodologies across the team. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS: 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or related roles, with at least 2+ years in an enterprise or senior CSM capacity. Experience in Gov Tech or the public sector is required. Deep expertise in Gainsight, including health scores, playbooks, reporting, and driving customer outcomes across a large portfolio. Proven ability to develop and execute enterprise-level customer success strategies, account plans, and multi-year strategic plans. Strong data analysis and visualization skills, including KPI dashboard development and data storytelling for executive audiences. Excellent communication, presentation, and executive-level stakeholder management skills, including experience engaging CXO-level contacts. Demonstrated ability to own renewal health, forecast risk, and drive retention across a large book of business. Experience partnering with Sales on upsell and cross-sell motions within an enterprise customer portfolio. Familiarity with AI tools and the ability to identify and track AI use cases and adoption within customer workflows. Willingness and ability to travel regularly for on-site customer engagement. DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS: Knowledge of the Accela Civic Platform and its applications. Experience with OKR frameworks and enterprise customer results strategies. Experience benchmarking customer outcomes and communicating performance against industry peers. Experience developing customer references, case studies, or participating in customer advisory boards (CABs). Strong understanding of competitive landscape in Gov Tech and ability to flag and communicate displacement risks. Experience leading or mentoring CSM teammates in an informal leadership capacity. Ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment while managing competing priorities across a large portfolio. ABOUT ACCELA For nearly 20 years, Accela has been an industry leader in designing and delivering government software to improve efficiency, increase citizen engagement and enable the development of thriving communities. Today, citizens are savvy to how services should be delivered, and expect a consistently convenient, openly transparent view into their local government. While government agencies struggle to do more with less, our mission has never been more critical. Accela provides a robust, cloud-based platform of government software solutions that accelerate growth, efficiency, and transparency in communities of all sizes. From planning, to building, to service request management and more, Accela’s SaaS offerings level the playing field for small and medium governments and enable smaller agencies to leverage larger city technologies. Our open and flexible technology helps agencies address specific needs today, while ensuring they are well prepared for the emerging challenges of the future. OUR COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUITY, AND INCLUSION Accela believes in developing and nurturing a workplace community where our differences are celebrated, and everyone feels a sense of psychological safety and belonging. Accela is committed to putting resources and attention towards evolving our practices, policies, and philosophies to enable diversity to thrive and to support equity in opportunity for everyone. COMPENSATION AND WELL-BEING The annual base salary range for this full-time position is $125,000 - $150,000 (less applicable taxes). The actual annual base salary offered may be adjusted based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, location, education, skills, training, and experience. In addition to an annual base salary, this position is eligible for an annual bonus target. This is a discretionary bonus awarded based on company and individual goal achievement. Accela’s U.S. team members will receive a generous benefits package consisting of options including flexible time off, comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, family planning benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan with company match, health savings account with company contributions, flexible spending account, life, accident, and disability coverage, business travel insurance, employee assistance programs, and other well-being benefits. Accela is an Equal Opportunity Employer/Affirmative Action Employer and will respond to requests for job accommodations. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, national origin, protected veteran status, or based on disability, gender identity, and sexual orientation #LI-Remote
